questions.topic: The Four Operations of Whole Numbers
questions.question: Peter answered 15 quiz questions for 29 points. A correct answer earns 3 points and a wrong answer loses 1 point. How many were correct?
questions.hint: Underline the given values. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Follow the guess-and-check table: each row must have 15 questions and score 29 points.

steps.title: Fill trial rows
steps.text: For 7 correct answers, the table has 8 wrong answers: 7×3 − 8×1 = 13, so that row fails. For 9 correct answers, 6 are wrong: 9×3 − 6×1 = 21, so that row also fails.

steps.title: Find the checked row
steps.text: The row with 11 correct answers has 4 wrong answers. Its score is 11×3 − 4×1 = 33 − 4 = 29, so it matches the required score.

zh-Hans.strategy: 按猜测检验表逐行试算；每一行的题数都要是15，得分都要检验是否为29。

steps.title: 填写试算行
steps.text: 结合上面的图示模型，答对7题时，答错8题：7×3 − 8×1 = 13，不符合。答对9题时，答错6题：9×3 − 6×1 = 21，也不符合。

questions.topic: The Four Operations of Whole Numbers
questions.question: A box had 480 yellow, orange, and black beads. After 18 yellow beads were added, 33 orange beads were removed, and black beads were doubled, the 3 colours were equal. Find each original count.
questions.hint: Underline the given values. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Use the aligned bars after the changes, where yellow and orange are 2 units each and black is 1 unit.

steps.title: Find one bar unit
steps.text: The bars show 5 equal units after the adjustments. Their total is 480 + 18 − 33 = 465, so 1 unit = 465 ÷ 5 = 93.

steps.title: Reverse the end pieces
steps.text: Yellow originally was 2 units minus the added 18: 2×93 − 18 = 168. Orange originally was 2 units plus the removed 33: 2×93 + 33 = 219. Black was 1 unit: 93.

zh-Hans.strategy: 看变化后的对齐单位条：黄色和橙色各是2单位，黑色是1单位。

steps.title: 求1个单位
steps.text: 变化后的3条共5个等单位，总数是480 + 18 − 33 = 465，所以1单位是465 ÷ 5 = 93。

questions.topic: The Four Operations of Whole Numbers
questions.question: 40% of Angie’s beads were red. After she lost 50 blue beads, the number of blue beads was reduced by 1/3 of its original count. How many beads did Angie have in the end?
questions.hint: Underline the given values. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Use the percentage bars: 40% is 2 units and 60% is 3 equal units.

steps.title: Read the blue bar
steps.text: The 60% blue bar is split into 3 equal 20% units. The lost 50 beads are one of those units, so 1 unit (20%) = 50 and the original blue amount is 3×50 = 150.

steps.title: Complete the whole bar
steps.text: The full 100% bar has 5 units, so it originally held 5×50 = 250 beads. After the 50 blue beads were lost, Angie had 250 − 50 = 200 beads.

zh-Hans.strategy: 使用百分比单位条：40%是2单位，60%是3个相等单位。

steps.title: 读出蓝珠条
steps.text: 60%的蓝珠条分成3个20%单位。丢失的50颗就是1个单位，所以1单位（20%）=50，原来蓝珠有3×50 = 150颗。

questions.topic: The Four Operations of Whole Numbers
questions.question: There were 820 orange buttons, 160 fewer than yellow buttons and 210 more than green buttons. Blue buttons were 1/3 of the total. How many buttons were there altogether?
questions.hint: Underline the given values. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Make the three-unit bar: blue is 1 unit, while orange, yellow, and green together are the other 2 units.

steps.title: Build the 2-unit section
steps.text: Yellow = 820 + 160 = 980 and green = 820 − 210 = 610. Thus orange + yellow + green = 820 + 980 + 610 = 2410; this is the 2-unit section of the bar.

steps.title: Complete all 3 units
steps.text: 1 unit = 2410 ÷ 2 = 1205. The whole bar has 3 units, so the total is 3×1205 = 3615 buttons.

zh-Hans.strategy: 画3单位条：蓝色是1单位，橙、黄、绿合起来是另2单位。

questions.questionZh: 有820个橙色纽扣，比黄色纽扣少160个，比绿色纽扣多210个。蓝色纽扣占总数的1/3。纽扣一共有多少个？

questions.hint: Label each money amount. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Use the guess-and-check table, keeping apples 2 more than oranges and deducting the payment for complete tens.

steps.title: Test table rows
steps.text: The 18-orange, 20-apple row gives $54 + $40 − $3 = $91, not $62. The 13-orange, 15-apple row gives $39 + $30 − $2 = $67, also not $62.

steps.title: Use the checked row
steps.text: For 12 oranges and 14 apples, there are 26 fruit, so the table deducts $2. Then $36 + $28 − $2 = $62, which matches the sale total.

questions.topic: The Four Operations of Whole Numbers
questions.question: 160 paperclips were in 4 boxes A, B, C, and D. 12 paperclips were moved from A to B, 1/3 of the paperclips in B were moved to C, and 17 paperclips were moved from D to C. The boxes then contained equal numbers of paperclips. Find the original number in each box.
questions.hint: Underline the given values. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Start with the final equal boxes, then follow the linked transfer bars backward.

steps.title: Read the final boxes
steps.text: Each final box has 160 ÷ 4 = 40 paperclips. Reversing the direct transfers gives A = 40 + 12 = 52 and D = 40 + 17 = 57.

steps.title: Use B's 2-unit and 3-unit bars
steps.text: The upper B bar shows 2 units = 40, so 1 unit = 20. Before one third was moved to C, B was 3 units = 60; undo the 12 moved from A: B = 60 − 12 = 48.

steps.title: Finish C's split bar
steps.text: C's final 40-bar contains 20 from B and 17 from D. Its original part is 40 − 20 − 17 = 3.

zh-Hans.strategy: 先读出最后4个相等的盒子，再沿着相连的转移单位条倒推。

steps.title: 读出最后每盒数量
steps.text: 最后每盒有160 ÷ 4 = 40个回形针。倒推直接转移，A原来有40 + 12 = 52个，D原来有40 + 17 = 57个。

steps.title: 使用B的2单位和3单位条
steps.text: B的上条显示2单位=40，所以1单位=20。移到C之前，B是3单位=60；再倒回从A移入的12个，B原来有60 − 12 = 48个。

steps.title: 完成C的分段条
steps.text: C最后的40个由从B来的20个、从D来的17个和原有部分组成，所以原有40 − 20 − 17 = 3个。

questions.questionZh: 160个回形针放在A、B、C、D四个盒子里。将12个回形针从A移到B，把B中回形针的1/3移到C，再将17个回形针从D移到C后，4个盒子里的回形针数量相等。求各盒原来的数量。

questions.topic: The Four Operations of Whole Numbers
questions.question: Michael had 80% more money than Alvin; Vanessa had 40% less. Michael and Alvin gave Vanessa money in a 3:2 ratio. Vanessa then had 2 times her original amount; Michael ended $144 above Vanessa. Find original amounts.
questions.hint: Label each money amount. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Use Alvin's 100% as the baseline, then use the 3:2 transfer strip and the final comparison bars.

steps.title: Set up the percentage bars
steps.text: The initial bars are Michael 180%, Alvin 100%, and Vanessa 60%. Vanessa doubles to 120%, so the amount transferred to her is 120% − 60% = 60%.

steps.title: Split the 60% transfer
steps.text: The M:A strip has 3 + 2 = 5 equal parts. Thus 1 part = 60% ÷ 5 = 12%; Michael gives 3×12% = 36% and Alvin gives 2×12% = 24%.

steps.title: Use the final difference
steps.text: On the stacked bars, Michael's 180% minus Vanessa's 120% minus Michael's 36% transfer leaves 24%, and this is $144. Thus 1% = $144 ÷ 24 = $6. The original amounts are 180×$6 = $1080, 100×$6 = $600, and 60×$6 = $360.

zh-Hans.strategy: 以Alvin的100%为基准，再使用3:2转移比例条和最后的对比条。

steps.title: 画出百分比条
steps.text: 起初Michael是180%，Alvin是100%，Vanessa是60%。Vanessa变为原来的2倍，即120%，所以她收到的是120% − 60% = 60%。

steps.title: 按3:2分60%
steps.text: M:A比例条共有3 + 2 = 5份，所以1份是60% ÷ 5 = 12%。Michael给3×12% = 36%，Alvin给2×12% = 24%。

steps.title: 利用最后差额
steps.text: 对齐条中，Michael的180%减Vanessa的120%，再减Michael转出的36%，余24%= $144。因此1%= $144 ÷ 24 = $6。原来Michael有180×$6 = $1080，Alvin有100×$6 = $600，Vanessa有60×$6 = $360。

questions.questionZh: 迈克尔的钱比阿尔文多80%；瓦妮莎的钱比阿尔文少40%。迈克尔和阿尔文按3:2的比例给瓦妮莎钱。之后瓦妮莎的钱变为原来的2倍；迈克尔最后比瓦妮莎多$144。求三人原来各有多少钱。

questions.topic: The Four Operations of Whole Numbers
questions.question: 2/5 of Tom’s toy cars were red. The number of green cars was 35 more than the number of red cars, and the remaining 15 cars were yellow. The cars were packed 5 to a box, with a single colour in each box. How many more red-and-green boxes than yellow boxes were there?
questions.hint: Underline the given values. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Read the five-cell strip r | r | g | g | g+y, then convert the resulting car counts to boxes.

steps.title: Find one strip unit
steps.text: Using the visual model above, The last cell is g+y = 35 + 15 = 50, so every equal cell is 50. The first four cells make 4×50 = 200 red-and-green cars; add the extra 35 green cars to get 235.

steps.title: Pack the labelled totals
steps.text: Red-and-green cars fill 235 ÷ 5 = 47 boxes. Yellow cars fill 15 ÷ 5 = 3 boxes. The difference is 47 − 3 = 44 boxes.

zh-Hans.strategy: 读出5格条r｜r｜g｜g｜g+y，再把得到的车辆数换成箱数。

steps.title: 求1个单位格
steps.text: 结合上面的图示模型，最后一格是g+y = 35 + 15 = 50，所以每个等格都是50。前4格共有4×50 = 200辆红绿车，再加多出的35辆绿车，红绿车共235辆。

questions.topic: The Four Operations of Whole Numbers
questions.question: David had 3/7 as many cards as Kristy. David gave away 9 cards and Kristy bought 18 cards. Their final numbers of cards were in the ratio 2:9. How many cards did they have altogether in the end?
questions.hint: Underline the given values. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Use the expanded 6:27 ratio bars and the rearranged Kristy strip.

steps.title: Expand the final ratio
steps.text: The 2:9 ratio is enlarged by 3 to 6:27, so the two final bars contain 33 equal units altogether. In the rearranged Kristy bar, 27 − 14 = 13 units remain to be valued.

steps.title: Value the rearranged section
steps.text: The seven repeated 3-card cells give 3×7 = 21 cards. Together with the bought 18 cards, this is 21 + 18 = 39 cards, matching the 13-unit section.

steps.title: Complete the 33-unit brace
steps.text: 13 units = 39, so 1 unit = 3. The full 33-unit brace is 33×3 = 99 cards.

zh-Hans.strategy: 使用扩成6:27的比例条和重排后的Kristy单位条。

steps.title: 扩展最后的比
steps.text: 把2:9同时乘3，得到6:27，所以最后两条共有33个等单位。重排后的Kristy条中，27 − 14 = 13单位需要求值。

steps.title: 给重排部分定值
steps.text: 7个重复的“3”卡片格共有3×7 = 21张；再加买入的18张，得到21 + 18 = 39张，正好对应13单位。

questions.topic: The Four Operations of Whole Numbers
questions.question: 2/3 of 42 students passed English. Of those who passed, 9/14 were girls. There were 4 more boys than girls among the students who failed. How many girls were in the class?
questions.hint: Underline the given values. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: First find the total who failed, then use the two-row failure bar with the extra 4 boys.

steps.title: Find the failure total
steps.text: Using the visual model above, The fraction who failed is 1 − 2/3 = 1/3. Thus 1/3×42 = 14 students failed.

steps.title: Split the failure bars
steps.text: The boys row has an extra terminal block of 4. Remove it from the total: 14 − 4 = 10. The two equal girls-and-boys parts are 10 ÷ 2 = 5, so 5 girls failed.

steps.title: Add the passing girls
steps.text: 2/3×42 = 28 students passed, and 9/14×28 = 18 of them were girls. Total girls = 18 + 5 = 23.

zh-Hans.strategy: 先求不及格总人数，再用“男生多4人”的两行失败人数条分配。

steps.title: 分开两条失败人数条
steps.text: 男生条右端多出4人。先从总数去掉这段：14 − 4 = 10；余下两段相等，所以10 ÷ 2 = 5名女生不及格。

questions.topic: The Four Operations of Whole Numbers
questions.question: Mrs Drew sold 120 butter and chocolate-chip cookies. Butter cost $2, chocolate-chip cost $4, and sales were $310. How many more butter cookies were sold?
questions.hint: Label each money amount. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Use the guess-and-check sales table, then compare the checked cookie counts.

steps.title: Check trial rows
steps.text: The table gives $340 for 70 butter and 50 chocolate-chip cookies, $320 for 80 and 40, and $308 for 86 and 34. None matches $310.

steps.title: Use the successful row
steps.text: For 85 butter and 35 chocolate-chip cookies, (85×$2) + (35×$4) = $170 + $140 = $310. This is the checked row.

steps.title: Compare the counts
steps.text: 85 − 35 = 50, so 50 more butter cookies were sold.

zh-Hans.strategy: 使用猜测检验销售表，再比较检验成功行中的两种饼干数量。

steps.title: 检验试算行
steps.text: 结合上面的图示模型，70块黄油和50块巧克力碎片饼干的销售额是$340；80和40时是$320；86和34时是$308，都不是$310。

steps.title: 比较数量
steps.text: 85 − 35 = 50，所以黄油饼干多卖50块。

questions.topic: The Four Operations of Whole Numbers
questions.question: Jane and John had 180 marbles. After Jane gave John marbles, John had 3 times his original count and Jane had 1/2 of John’s count. Find original counts.
questions.hint: Underline the given values. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Use the two aligned initial bars: John is 2 units and Jane is 7 units, for 9 units altogether.

steps.title: Read the 9-unit total
steps.text: The aligned bars show 2 John units plus 7 Jane units, making 9 units = 180 marbles. Therefore 1 unit = 180 ÷ 9 = 20.

steps.title: Read each initial bar
steps.text: John's 2-unit bar is 2×20 = 40 marbles. Jane's 7-unit bar is 7×20 = 140 marbles.

zh-Hans.strategy: 使用两条对齐的原有数量条：John是2单位，Jane是7单位，共9单位。

steps.title: 读出9单位总数
steps.text: 图中John的2单位加Jane的7单位，共9单位=180颗弹珠。因此1单位=180 ÷ 9 = 20颗。

steps.title: 读出各自的原有条
steps.text: John的2单位是2×20 = 40颗。Jane的7单位是7×20 = 140颗。

questions.topic: The Four Operations of Whole Numbers
questions.question: 3/5 of a number exceeds 1/2 of the number by 12. Find the difference between the number and its fourth multiple.
questions.hint: Underline the given values. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Rewrite both fractions in tenths so the 10-unit, 6-unit, and 5-unit bars can be compared directly.

steps.title: Align the fraction bars
steps.text: 3/5 = 6/10 and 1/2 = 5/10. The 6-unit bar exceeds the 5-unit bar by 1 unit, and that one-unit difference is 12.

steps.title: Complete the number bar
steps.text: The whole number is 10 units, so it is 10×12 = 120. Its fourth multiple is 4×120 = 480.

zh-Hans.strategy: 把两个分数都改写成十分之几，使10单位、6单位和5单位条能直接比较。

questions.topic: The Four Operations of Whole Numbers
questions.question: 105 students were in 3 groups. 1/3 of group 1 moved to group 2, and 20% of group 3 moved to group 2. Then 15 students moved from group 1 to group 3. The 3 groups then had equal numbers of students. Find the original number in each group.
questions.hint: Underline the given values. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Use the equal final group size, then read the 80%/20% transfer bar and the 3-unit group-1 bar.

steps.title: Find group 3 from its percentage bar
steps.text: Each final group has 105 ÷ 3 = 35 students. After 15 arrive from group 1, group 3 had 35 − 15 = 20; this is the 80% part of its bar. The 20% transferred to group 2 is 20 ÷ 80×20 = 5, so group 3 originally had 20 + 5 = 25.

steps.title: Find group 1 from its 3-unit bar
steps.text: Before the final 15 left group 1, it had 35 + 15 = 50 students. This is the 2-unit part after 1/3 moved away, so 1 unit = 50 ÷ 2 = 25 and group 1 originally had 3×25 = 75.

steps.title: Find group 2
steps.text: Group 2 receives 25 from group 1 and 5 from group 3, then ends with 35. Its original number was 35 − 25 − 5 = 5.

zh-Hans.strategy: 利用最后每组相等的人数，再读80%/20%转移条和第1组的3单位条。

steps.title: 从百分比条求第3组
steps.text: 最后每组有105 ÷ 3 = 35人。第3组先有35 − 15 = 20人，这对应条中的80%。转到第2组的20%是20 ÷ 80×20 = 5人，所以第3组原来有20 + 5 = 25人。

steps.title: 从3单位条求第1组
steps.text: 第1组最后转走15人之前有35 + 15 = 50人，这是转走1/3后留下的2单位。所以1单位=50 ÷ 2 = 25人，第1组原来有3×25 = 75人。

steps.title: 求第2组
steps.text: 第2组从第1组收到25人，从第3组收到5人，最后有35人。因此原来有35 − 25 − 5 = 5人。

questions.topic: The Four Operations of Whole Numbers
questions.question: In 1998, Tom was 4 times Jack’s age and Peter was 2 times Jack’s age. Tom was 36. Find Peter’s age in 2000 and their total age in 2003.
questions.hint: Underline the given values. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Use the 4-unit, 2-unit, and 1-unit age bars for 1998, then follow the timeline forward.

steps.title: Read the 1998 unit bars
steps.text: Tom's 4 equal units total 36, so 1 unit = 36 ÷ 4 = 9. Peter's 2 units are 18 and Jack's 1 unit is 9 in 1998.

steps.title: Move to 2000
steps.text: The timeline advances 2 years from 1998 to 2000. Peter was 18 + 2 = 20 years old.

steps.title: Move to 2003
steps.text: By 2000 Tom is 36 + 2 = 38, Peter is 20, and Jack is 9 + 2 = 11. Advance each by 3 more years: (38+3) + (20+3) + (11+3) = 41 + 23 + 14 = 78.

zh-Hans.strategy: 使用1998年的4单位、2单位、1单位年龄条，再沿时间线向前推。

steps.title: 读出1998年的单位条
steps.text: Tom的4个等单位共36岁，所以1单位=36 ÷ 4 = 9岁。Peter的2单位是18岁，Jack的1单位是9岁。

steps.title: 推到2000年
steps.text: 从1998年到2000年经过2年，Peter是18 + 2 = 20岁。

questions.question: Thomas and Zack were each given the same number of toy cars. Zack then had 2 times as many toy cars as he had at first. 2/3 of Zack’s number then equalled 1/2 of Thomas’s number then. Thomas had 36 more toy cars than Zack then. Find (a) the total number of toy cars given and (b) Thomas’s initial number of toy cars.
questions.hint: Underline the given values. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Use the aligned Zack and Thomas unit bars: the same 3 given units appear in both rows.

steps.title: Value the final-bar difference
steps.text: Zack's final bar has 6 units and Thomas's has 8 units. The final 2 extra Thomas units are labelled 36, so 1 unit = 36 ÷ 2 = 18.

steps.title: Read the given and initial sections
steps.text: The two g sections contain 3 + 3 = 6 units, so the total given is 6×18 = 108 cars. Thomas's initial section is the remaining 5 units, so it is 5×18 = 90 cars.

zh-Hans.strategy: 使用Zack和Thomas的对齐单位条：两行都有相同的3个“g”赠送单位。

steps.title: 给最后数量差定单位值
steps.text: Zack最后有6单位，Thomas最后有8单位。Thomas多出的2单位标为36，所以1单位=36 ÷ 2 = 18。

steps.title: 读出赠送部分和原有部分
steps.text: 两段“g”共有3 + 3 = 6单位，所以共送出6×18 = 108辆。Thomas原有部分是剩下的5单位，即5×18 = 90辆。

questions.topic: The Four Operations of Whole Numbers
questions.question: Joanne sold cookies, cakes, and muffins. There were 140 more cookies than cakes. 1/5 of the cookies and 2/3 of the cakes were chocolate. The number of chocolate cookies equalled the number of chocolate cakes. The number of butter cakes equalled the number of butter muffins. The number of cakes was 3/4 of the number of muffins. (a) How many more butter items than chocolate items were there? (b) If a cookie cost $0.50, a cake cost $1.50, and a muffin cost $2, what were the total sales?
questions.hint: Label each money amount. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Use the flavour-coded unit bars: cookies have 10 units, cakes 3 units, and muffins 4 units.

steps.title: Count the flavour units
steps.text: Use 1/5 = 2/10 to show 2 chocolate units in the 10-unit cookie bar. The cake bar has 2 chocolate and 1 butter unit; the muffin bar has 3 chocolate and 1 butter unit. Thus chocolate has 2 + 2 + 3 = 7 units, while butter has 8 + 1 + 1 = 10 units.

steps.title: Value the bars
steps.text: The 7 chocolate units equal 140, so 1 unit = 140 ÷ 7 = 20. Butter totals 10×20 = 200, so butter exceeds chocolate by 200 − 140 = 60 items.

zh-Hans.strategy: 使用按口味着色的单位条：饼干10单位，蛋糕3单位，松饼4单位。

steps.title: 数出口味单位
steps.text: 用1/5 = 2/10，可知10单位饼干条中有2个巧克力单位。蛋糕条有2个巧克力和1个黄油单位；松饼条有3个巧克力和1个黄油单位。因此巧克力共有2 + 2 + 3 = 7单位，黄油共有8 + 1 + 1 = 10单位。

questions.topic: The Four Operations of Whole Numbers
questions.question: 4656 people attended a concert. After 1/4 of men and 1/3 of women left, 120 more women remained. How many more women than men were there at first?
questions.hint: Underline the given values. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Read the two aligned remaining-person bars as 5 equal men units and 4 equal women units plus four extra blocks of 120.

steps.title: Remove the four extra blocks
steps.text: The bars together show 9 equal units plus 4 × 120 people. So the 9 equal units are 4656 − 4 × 120 = 4176.

steps.title: Find one bar unit
steps.text: Each equal unit is 4176 ÷ 9 = 464 people. The men bar is 5 × 464 = 2320, while the women bar is 4 × 464 + 480 = 2336.

steps.title: Compare the two bars
steps.text: The women bar exceeds the men bar by 2336 − 2320 = 16.

zh-Hans.strategy: 把两条对齐的剩余人数线段图读作：男士有 5 个相等单位，女士有 4 个相等单位再加 4 块 120。

steps.title: 先扣除 4 块额外人数
steps.text: 两条线段图合共是 9 个相等单位加 4 × 120 人。因此 9 个相等单位是 4656 − 4 × 120 = 4176。

questions.topic: The Four Operations of Whole Numbers
questions.question: 1/3 of 120 oranges were ripe and the rest overripe. After 40 were removed, overripe oranges were 3/4 of the remainder. Find removed ripe, removed overripe, and final difference.
questions.hint: Underline the given values. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Use the first thirds bar for the original oranges, then the second 4-unit bar for the 80 oranges left.

steps.title: Read the original thirds bar
steps.text: One of the 3 equal parts is ripe: 120 ÷ 3 = 40 ripe oranges. The other 2 parts are overripe: 2 × 40 = 80.

steps.title: Read the remaining 4-unit bar
steps.text: After 40 oranges are removed, 80 remain. The bar has 4 equal units, so 1 unit is 80 ÷ 4 = 20; its 3 overripe units are 3 × 20 = 60.

steps.title: Compare each type
steps.text: Overripe removed = 80 − 60 = 20. Ripe remaining is 1 unit = 20, so ripe removed = 40 − 20 = 20; the final difference is 60 − 20 = 40.

zh-Hans.strategy: 先用 3 等分条表示原来的橙子，再用剩下 80 个橙子的 4 等分条。

steps.title: 读原来的 3 等分条
steps.text: 3 个相等部分中有 1 部分是成熟橙子：120 ÷ 3 = 40 个。另 2 部分是过熟橙子：2 × 40 = 80 个。

steps.title: 读剩下的 4 等分条
steps.text: 取走 40 个后剩 80 个。该条有 4 个相等单位，所以 1 个单位是 80 ÷ 4 = 20；其中 3 个过熟单位是 3 × 20 = 60。

steps.title: 比较两类橙子
steps.text: 取走的过熟橙子为 80 − 60 = 20 个。剩下的成熟橙子为 1 个单位，即 20 个，所以取走的成熟橙子为 40 − 20 = 20 个；最后相差 60 − 20 = 40 个。

zh-Hans.answerCheck: 验算：(a) 20 个过熟橙子；(b) 20 个成熟橙子；(c) 过熟橙子多 40 个。

questions.question: Mrs Crawford spent 1/3 of salary on education and 1/4 of the remainder on food. Savings:transport was 2:3; education exceeded transport by $265. Find 6 months of education spending.
questions.hint: Label each money amount. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Follow the monthly-budget strip: education is one quarter of the whole, food is one half, and the final quarter is split into savings 2 parts and transport 3 parts.

steps.title: Read the budget strip
steps.text: Using the visual model above, The education block is 1/4 of the monthly salary. Food takes 1/2, leaving 1/4 for savings and transport; transport is 3/5 of that last quarter, or 3/20 of the whole.

steps.title: Use the labelled gap
steps.text: The brace shows education minus transport: 1/4 − 3/20 = 1/10 of the salary, and this gap is $265. Education is 1/4 ÷ 1/10 = 2.5 such gaps, so monthly education is 2.5 × $265 = $662.50.

steps.title: Extend the education block to 6 months
steps.text: For 6 months, education spending is 6 × $662.50 = $3975.

zh-Hans.strategy: 按照每月预算条：教育占整体的 1/4，食物占 1/2，最后的 1/4 再按储蓄 2 份、交通 3 份分开。

steps.title: 读预算线段图
steps.text: 教育块是月薪的 1/4。食物占 1/2，余下 1/4 给储蓄和交通；交通占这最后 1/4 的 3/5，即整体的 3/20。

steps.title: 利用标出的差额
steps.text: 括号表示教育减交通：1/4 − 3/20 = 月薪的 1/10，而这个差额是 $265。教育费是 1/4 ÷ 1/10 = 2.5 个这样的差额，所以每月教育费为 2.5 × $265 = $662.50。

steps.title: 把教育块延伸到 6 个月

questions.question: Tank A was 2/3 full. 1/2 of its water filled tank B from 1/4 full to full. Tank A measured 12 cm × 10 cm × 20 cm. Find total tank capacity in litres.
questions.hint: Label the given measures. Draw a model, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Use the calculation box to get the transfer from tank A, then read it as 4 of the 5 equal capacity parts of tank B.

steps.title: Complete the tank A box
steps.text: Using the visual model above, Tank A holds 12 × 10 × 20 = 2400 cm³. At 2/3 full it contains 1600 cm³, and the transferred half is 1600 ÷ 2 = 800 cm³.

steps.title: Fill the 5-part B bar
steps.text: The 800 cm³ transfer fills 4 of B's 5 equal parts. Therefore 1 part is 800 ÷ 4 = 200 cm³ and full tank B is 5 × 200 = 1000 cm³.

steps.title: Add and convert the capacities
steps.text: Together the tanks hold 2400 + 1000 = 3400 cm³ = 3.4 L.

en.answerCheck: Check: total capacity is 3400 cm³, which is 3.4 L.

zh-Hans.strategy: 先用计算框求出从 A 倒出的水，再把它看作 B 的 5 个等容积单位中的 4 个。

steps.title: 完成水箱 A 的计算框
steps.text: 结合上面的图示模型，水箱 A 的容积为 12 × 10 × 20 = 2400 cm³。装了 2/3 时有 1600 cm³，倒出其中一半为 1600 ÷ 2 = 800 cm³。

steps.title: 填入 B 的 5 等分条
steps.text: 倒入的 800 cm³ 填满 B 的 5 个等容积部分中的 4 个。因此 1 份为 800 ÷ 4 = 200 cm³，水箱 B 全满为 5 × 200 = 1000 cm³。

zh-Hans.answerCheck: 验算：总容积为 3400 cm³，即 3.4 L。

questions.question: Mrs Bowles bought 2.5 kg fish and 1.5 kg more prawns. Change from $50 was $5.50; prawns cost $3/kg more. How much did she spend on prawns?
questions.hint: Label each money amount. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Use the aligned half-kilogram cost bars: 8 prawn price units and 5 fish price units, after separating the $3/kg prawn premium.

steps.title: Set up the two cost strips
steps.text: Prawns weigh 2.5 + 1.5 = 4 kg, or 8 half-kg units. Fish weigh 2.5 kg, or 5 half-kg units. The purchase cost is $50 − $5.50 = $44.50.

steps.title: Remove the premium from the common units
steps.text: The prawn premium is 4 × $3 = $12. Removing it leaves $44.50 − $12 = $32.50 for the 13 equal half-kg price units, so each unit is $32.50 ÷ 13 = $2.50.

steps.title: Restore the prawn premium
steps.text: The 8 prawn units cost 8 × $2.50 = $20, then add the $12 premium: $20 + $12 = $32.

en.answerCheck: Check: $20 + $12 = $32, so the amount spent on prawns is $32.

questions.question: A 60 cm × 40 cm × 25 cm container was 4/5 full; its water level fell 5 cm. Remaining water filled a tank and basin, whose capacity was 1/4 of the tank. Find tank water height.
questions.hint: Label the given measures. Draw a model, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Find the remaining volume first, then use the 1-unit basin to 3-unit tank capacity bar before calculating the tank height.

steps.title: Find the water represented by the brace
steps.text: The original water depth is 4/5 × 25 = 20 cm. After a 5 cm fall, the depth is 15 cm, so the remaining volume is 60 × 40 × 15 = 36000 cm³.

steps.title: Split the 4-unit capacity bar
steps.text: The basin is 1 equal unit and the tank is 3 equal units, making 4 units altogether. The tank therefore receives 3/4 × 36000 = 27000 cm³.

steps.title: Use the tank base annotation
steps.text: The tank base area is 18 × 15 = 270 cm². Its water height is 27000 ÷ 270 = 100 cm.

en.answerCheck: Check: 270 cm² × 100 cm = 27000 cm³, so the tank water height is 100 cm.

zh-Hans.strategy: 先求总括号表示的剩余水量，再用水盆 1 份、水箱 3 份的容量条，最后计算水箱水高。

steps.title: 求总括号所示水量
steps.text: 原来水深为 4/5 × 25 = 20 cm。下降 5 cm 后水深为 15 cm，所以剩余体积为 60 × 40 × 15 = 36000 cm³。

steps.title: 分配 4 个容量单位
steps.text: 水盆是 1 个相等单位，水箱是 3 个相等单位，合共 4 个单位。因此水箱得到 3/4 × 36000 = 27000 cm³。

zh-Hans.answerCheck: 验算：270 cm² × 100 cm = 27000 cm³，所以水箱水高是 100 cm。

questions.question: ABCD is a 320 cm-perimeter rectangle of length 96 cm. 2 squares of side 12 cm are placed inside. Find the shaded area, using π = 3.14.
questions.hint: Label the given measures. Draw a model, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Use the composite diagram: outer rectangle minus the two squares, then add the four curved segments inside the squares.

steps.title: Find the outer rectangle area
steps.text: Using the visual model above, Its breadth is (320 − 96 − 96) ÷ 2 = 64 cm. Thus the outer rectangle has area 96 × 64 = 6144 cm².

steps.title: Find the four curved segments
steps.text: Each labelled segment is a quarter-circle minus a half-square triangle: 1/4 × 3.14 × 12² − 1/2 × 12 × 12 = 41.04 cm². The two squares contain 4 such segments, with total area 4 × 41.04 = 164.16 cm².

steps.title: Combine the regions shown
steps.text: Start with the rectangle, remove 2 squares, and add the 4 shaded segments: 6144 − 2 × 12² + 164.16 = 6020.16 cm².

zh-Hans.strategy: 按照组合图计算：大长方形减去 2 个正方形，再加回正方形内的 4 块曲边阴影。

steps.title: 求 4 块曲边部分
steps.text: 图中每一块曲边部分是四分之一圆减去半个正方形三角形：1/4 × 3.14 × 12² − 1/2 × 12 × 12 = 41.04 cm²。2 个正方形共有 4 块，面积为 4 × 41.04 = 164.16 cm²。

steps.title: 合并图中的区域
steps.text: 从大长方形开始，减去 2 个正方形，再加回 4 块阴影：6144 − 2 × 12² + 164.16 = 6020.16 cm²。

questions.question: Joanne bought 3 pens and 2 rulers for $10.80; Alice bought 5 pens and 4 rulers for $19.20. Nick spent $13.20 on 2 rulers and pens. How many pens did Nick buy?
questions.hint: Label each money amount. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Use the aligned equation table to make 4 rulers appear in both rows, subtract to price a pen, then use Nick's payment.

steps.title: Align the two purchase rows
steps.text: Double 3 pens + 2 rulers = $10.80 to get 6 pens + 4 rulers = $21.60. This aligns with 5 pens + 4 rulers = $19.20.

steps.title: Subtract the aligned rows
steps.text: Subtracting gives 1 pen = $21.60 − $19.20 = $2.40. Then the table's first row gives 2 rulers = $10.80 − 3 × $2.40 = $3.60.

steps.title: Use Nick's row
steps.text: Nick spent $13.20. After paying $3.60 for 2 rulers, he has $13.20 − $3.60 = $9.60 for pens. Thus he buys $9.60 ÷ $2.40 = 4 pens.

en.answerCheck: Check: 2 rulers cost $3.60 and 4 pens cost 4 × $2.40 = $9.60; together they cost $13.20. Nick bought 4 pens.

questions.question: Frankie, Martin, and Jeremy earned $120. Jeremy earned 1/2 Frankie; Martin earned 3 times Jeremy and gave Frankie 1/4 of his money. Jeremy then earned 4 times his earlier amount. How much more did Jeremy have?
questions.hint: Label each money amount. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Read the Before bars as 2, 3, and 1 equal units, then follow the arrow and compare the End bars.

steps.title: Find the value of a unit
steps.text: Before the transfer, Frankie, Martin, and Jeremy have 2 + 3 + 1 = 6 units worth $120. So 1 unit is $120 ÷ 6 = $20.

steps.title: Follow the transfer arrow
steps.text: Martin's 3 units are $60, and the arrow marks 1/4 of this as $15. Frankie therefore changes from 2 units to 2 × $20 + $15 = $55.

steps.title: Compare the End bars
steps.text: Jeremy's End bar has 4 units, or 4 × $20 = $80. The final difference is $80 − $55 = $25.

en.answerCheck: Check: Jeremy has $80 and Frankie has $55, so Jeremy had $25 more.

zh-Hans.strategy: 把 Before 的三条金额条读作 2、3、1 个相等单位，再沿箭头处理转给 Frankie 的钱，并比较 End 的两条金额条。

steps.title: 求每个单位的金额
steps.text: 转钱前，Frankie、Martin、Jeremy 的单位数为 2 + 3 + 1 = 6，共 $120。因此 1 个单位为 $120 ÷ 6 = $20。

steps.title: 沿转账箭头计算
steps.text: Martin 的 3 个单位是 $60，箭头标示其中的 1/4 为 $15。Frankie 因而由 2 个单位变为 2 × $20 + $15 = $55。

steps.title: 比较 End 的金额条
steps.text: Jeremy 的 End 条有 4 个单位，即 4 × $20 = $80。最后相差 $80 − $55 = $25。

zh-Hans.answerCheck: 验算：Jeremy 有 $80，Frankie 有 $55，所以 Jeremy 多 $25。

questions.question: A 90 cm × 10 cm tank was filled by taps at 4 L/min and 10 L per 2 min. After 1.5 min it was 1/4 full. Find tank height.
questions.hint: Label the given measures. Draw a model, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Use the two-row flow table to get the one shaded quarter of the tank, then scale the tank bar to full capacity.

steps.title: Merge the two tap rates
steps.text: Using the visual model above, Tap A supplies 4 L/min. Tap B supplies 10 L ÷ 2 min = 5 L/min, so together they supply 9 L/min. In 1.5 min they deliver 9 × 1.5 = 13.5 L = 13500 cm³.

steps.title: Scale the shaded quarter
steps.text: The shaded section is 1 of 4 equal tank-capacity parts. Thus the full tank volume is 4 × 13500 = 54000 cm³.

steps.title: Use the base rectangle
steps.text: The base area is 90 × 10 = 900 cm². Height = full volume ÷ base area = 54000 ÷ 900 = 60 cm.

en.answerCheck: Check: 900 cm² × 60 cm = 54000 cm³, so the tank height is 60 cm.

zh-Hans.strategy: 用两行进水速率表求水箱中涂色的 1/4，再把容量条放大到全满。

steps.title: 合并两个水龙头的流速
steps.text: 结合上面的图示模型，水龙头 A 每 min 流 4 L。水龙头 B 每 2 min 流 10 L，即 10 L ÷ 2 min = 5 L/min，所以合共 9 L/min。1.5 min 流入 9 × 1.5 = 13.5 L = 13500 cm³。

steps.title: 把涂色的 1/4 放大
steps.text: 涂色部分是水箱 4 个相等容量部分中的 1 个。因此水箱全满容积为 4 × 13500 = 54000 cm³。

zh-Hans.answerCheck: 验算：900 cm² × 60 cm = 54000 cm³，所以水箱高是 60 cm。

questions.question: PQRS is enlarged to VWRT; area increases 226 cm². PQRS length is 2 times breadth. Find PQRS perimeter.
questions.hint: Label the given measures. Draw a model, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Use the nested-rectangle diagram: remove the 4 cm by 4 cm corner square, then express the two remaining added rectangles with PQ = 2PS.

steps.title: Remove the corner square
steps.text: The two 4 cm extensions make the highlighted corner a 4 cm × 4 cm square of area 16 cm². The two other added rectangles therefore have area 226 − 16 = 210 cm².

steps.title: Use the two added rectangles
steps.text: Their areas are 4 × PS and 4 × PQ, so 4PS + 4PQ = 210. The diagram gives PQ = 2PS, hence 4PS + 4(2PS) = 210 and 12PS = 210.

steps.title: Find the original perimeter
steps.text: PS = 17.5 cm and PQ = 35 cm. Thus the perimeter of PQRS is 2 × (17.5 + 35) = 105 cm.

en.answerCheck: Check: 4 × 17.5 + 4 × 35 + 16 = 226, and the perimeter is 105 cm.

zh-Hans.strategy: 使用嵌套矩形图：先扣除 4 cm × 4 cm 的角正方形，再用 PQ = 2PS 表示余下的 2 个新增长方形。

steps.title: 扣除角上的正方形
steps.text: 两条 4 cm 的扩边形成高亮的 4 cm × 4 cm 角正方形，面积为 16 cm²。因此另外 2 个新增长方形的面积为 226 − 16 = 210 cm²。

steps.title: 使用 2 个新增长方形
steps.text: 它们的面积分别为 4 × PS 和 4 × PQ，所以 4PS + 4PQ = 210。图中给出 PQ = 2PS，因此 4PS + 4(2PS) = 210，即 12PS = 210。

steps.title: 求原矩形的周长
steps.text: PS = 17.5 cm，PQ = 35 cm。因此 PQRS 的周长为 2 × (17.5 + 35) = 105 cm。

questions.question: Tank A was 30% full. 2/5 of its water filled 1/2 of empty tank B, sized 15 cm × 12 cm × 25 cm. How much water is now needed to fill A?
questions.hint: Label the given measures. Draw a model, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Use the first 5-part bar to recover tank A's initial water from the transfer, then use the 10-part percent bar to find full capacity.

steps.title: Label the transferred two fifths
steps.text: Tank B holds 15 × 12 × 25 = 4500 cm³, so its half-full amount is 2250 cm³. On A's first bar, this is 2 of the 5 equal initial-water parts.

steps.title: Complete the first bar
steps.text: One fifth is 2250 ÷ 2 = 1125 cm³, so all 5 initial parts total 5 × 1125 = 5625 cm³. The 3 untransferred parts are 3 × 1125 = 3375 cm³.

steps.title: Read the 10% bar
steps.text: The 5625 cm³ initial amount is 30%, or 3 of 10 equal percent parts. Thus full capacity is 5625 ÷ 3 × 10 = 18750 cm³, and the water needed is 18750 − 3375 = 15375 cm³.

en.answerCheck: Check: 30% of 18750 cm³ is 5625 cm³; after 2250 cm³ is transferred, 15375 cm³ is needed to fill A.

zh-Hans.strategy: 先用第一个 5 等分条从倒出的水量还原 A 原有水量，再用 10 个百分比格求满箱容积。

steps.title: 标出倒出的 2/5
steps.text: 水箱 B 的容积为 15 × 12 × 25 = 4500 cm³，半满为 2250 cm³。在 A 的第一条中，这就是原有水量的 5 个相等部分中的 2 个。

steps.title: 读 10% 百分比条
steps.text: 原有的 5625 cm³ 是 30%，即 10 个相等百分比格中的 3 格。因此满箱容积为 5625 ÷ 3 × 10 = 18750 cm³，所需水量为 18750 − 3375 = 15375 cm³。

zh-Hans.answerCheck: 验算：18750 cm³ 的 30% 是 5625 cm³；倒出 2250 cm³ 后，装满 A 还需 15375 cm³。

questions.question: Patrick, Jemima, Angela had $482. Angela had 3/4 of Jemima; after Patrick used $125, he had 1/4 less than Jemima. Find initial Patrick-plus-Angela total.
questions.hint: Label each money amount. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Use the three aligned money bars: Patrick after spending has 6 units, Jemima has 8, Angela has 3, and the separate $125 block restores the original total.

steps.title: Read the total brace
steps.text: The shaded bars contain 6 + 8 + 3 = 17 equal units, and the extra spending block is $125. Thus 17 units = $482 − $125 = $357.

steps.title: Find the unit value
steps.text: One unit is $357 ÷ 17 = $21. Patrick's original bar is 6 units plus $125, while Angela's bar is 3 units.

steps.title: Bracket Patrick and Angela together
steps.text: Their required total is 9 units + $125 = 9 × $21 + $125 = $314.

questions.question: Red:yellow beads were 10:9. After 30 yellow beads were used, the ratio was 5:2. Red cost $0.90 each; yellow cost $0.20 more. Find original cost.
questions.hint: Label each money amount. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Use the before-and-after ratio strips. Double the 5:2 after ratio so that its 10 red units align with the 10 red units before use.

steps.title: Align the red rows
steps.text: Before use, the strips show red:yellow = 10:9. Double the after-use ratio 5:2 to get 10:4, matching the 10 red units.

steps.title: Use the yellow removal bracket
steps.text: Yellow changes from 9 units to 4 units, so 5 units represent the 30 used beads. One unit is 30 ÷ 5 = 6 beads; originally there were 10 × 6 = 60 red and 9 × 6 = 54 yellow beads.

steps.title: Price the original two bars
steps.text: Red costs 60 × $0.90 = $54. Yellow costs $0.90 + $0.20 = $1.10 each, so 54 × $1.10 = $59.40. Together they cost $113.40.

zh-Hans.strategy: 使用前后比的线段条。把用后 5:2 的比双倍成 10:4，使红珠的 10 个单位与原来对齐。

steps.title: 对齐红珠两行
steps.text: 用前的线段条为红:黄 = 10:9。把用后的 5:2 双倍，得到 10:4，正好与原来红珠的 10 个单位对齐。

steps.title: 使用黄珠减少的括号
steps.text: 黄珠从 9 个单位变为 4 个单位，所以减少的 5 个单位代表用掉的 30 颗。1 个单位为 30 ÷ 5 = 6 颗；原来红珠有 10 × 6 = 60 颗，黄珠有 9 × 6 = 54 颗。

questions.question: A semicircle and small triangle lie in triangle PQR; PQ is the semicircle diameter. Using the given 36 cm figure and π = 3.14, find the unshaded area.
questions.hint: Label the given measures. Draw a model, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Use the labelled triangle-and-semicircle diagram: find the whole triangle, then subtract the semicircle and the lower shaded triangle.

steps.title: Find the whole triangle
steps.text: Using the visual model above, Triangle PQR has base PQ = 12 cm and height 36 cm, so its area is 12 × 36 ÷ 2 = 216 cm².

steps.title: Find the two shaded pieces
steps.text: The semicircle radius is 12 ÷ 2 = 6 cm, so its area is 1/2 × 3.14 × 6² = 56.52 cm². The lower triangle height is 36 − 6 − 5 = 25 cm, so its area is 8 × 25 ÷ 2 = 100 cm².

steps.title: Leave the two unshaded side regions
steps.text: Unshaded area = 216 − 56.52 − 100 = 59.48 cm².

zh-Hans.strategy: 使用标有尺寸的三角形和半圆图：先求整个大三角形，再减去半圆和下方阴影三角形。

steps.title: 求整个大三角形
steps.text: 结合上面的图示模型，△PQR 的底 PQ = 12 cm，高为 36 cm，因此面积为 12 × 36 ÷ 2 = 216 cm²。

steps.title: 求 2 个阴影部分
steps.text: 半圆半径为 12 ÷ 2 = 6 cm，面积为 1/2 × 3.14 × 6² = 56.52 cm²。下方三角形的高为 36 − 6 − 5 = 25 cm，面积为 8 × 25 ÷ 2 = 100 cm²。

questions.questionZh: 三角形PQR内有一个半圆和一个小三角形；PQ是半圆的直径。根据图中给出的36 cm，取π = 3.14，求非阴影部分的面积。

questions.question: A 70 cm × 45 cm × 50 cm tank filled from 2 taps at 7 L/min each for 10 min. 30% was poured into a tub to make it 3/10 full. Find water needed to fill both.
questions.hint: Label the given measures. Draw a model, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Follow the flow timeline to 140 L, then use the 4-part tub bar and 10-part tank bar to add the two empty amounts.

steps.title: Follow the flow timeline
steps.text: Using the visual model above, The two taps give 7 + 7 = 14 L/min. In 10 min they collect 14 × 10 = 140 L = 140000 cm³. The tub receives 30% of this, or 42 L.

steps.title: Read the 4-part tub bar
steps.text: The 42 L fills 3 of 4 equal tub parts. One part is 42 ÷ 3 = 14 L, so the empty tub part is 14 L = 14000 cm³.

steps.title: Read the 10-part tank bar and add
steps.text: The tank retains 70% of 140 L = 98 L = 98000 cm³. Its full capacity is 70 × 45 × 50 = 157500 cm³, so its empty amount is 157500 − 98000 = 59500 cm³. Total needed is 59500 + 14000 = 73500 cm³ = 73.5 L.

en.answerCheck: Check: 59500 cm³ + 14000 cm³ = 73500 cm³ or 73.5 L.

zh-Hans.strategy: 按照进水时间线先得到 140 L，再用水盆的 4 等分条和水箱的 10 格百分比条相加两个空缺量。

steps.title: 沿进水时间线计算
steps.text: 结合上面的图示模型，两个水龙头的流量为 7 + 7 = 14 L/min。10 min 收集 14 × 10 = 140 L = 140000 cm³。水盆得到其中的 30%，即 42 L。

steps.title: 读水盆的 4 等分条
steps.text: 42 L 填满水盆 4 个相等部分中的 3 个。1 个部分为 42 ÷ 3 = 14 L，因此水盆空缺的 1 个部分为 14 L = 14000 cm³。

questions.question: Clocks chime every 3 min, 4 min offset by 1 min, and 6 min. They chime together at 10:45 am. How many more joint chimes occur in the next hour?
questions.hint: Underline the given values. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Use the three-row multiples timeline for the 3-, 4-, and 6-minute intervals, beginning just after the chime together at 10:45 am.

steps.title: Mark each clock's timeline row
steps.text: Using the visual model above, List the next 60 minutes in separate rows: multiples of 3 for the first clock, multiples of 4 for the second, and multiples of 6 for the third.

steps.title: Circle the common timeline marks
steps.text: The values shared by all three rows are 12, 24, 36, 48, and 60 minutes. These are the common multiples of 3, 4, and 6 in the next hour.

steps.title: Count the circled times
steps.text: Starting from 10:45 am, the five marked joint chimes are at 10:57 am, 11:09 am, 11:21 am, 11:33 am, and 11:45 am.

en.answerCheck: Check: the timeline circles 12, 24, 36, 48, and 60 minutes, so there are 5 times.

zh-Hans.strategy: 从 10:45 am 同时鸣响后的时刻开始，用 3 分钟、4 分钟和 6 分钟的三行倍数时间线。

steps.title: 标出每个时钟的时间线
steps.text: 结合上面的图示模型，在接下来的 60 分钟内分别列出：第一个时钟的 3 的倍数、第二个时钟的 4 的倍数、第三个时钟的 6 的倍数。

steps.title: 圈出共同的时间点
steps.text: 三行共同出现的是 12、24、36、48、60 分钟。这些是 3、4、6 在下一小时内的公倍数。

zh-Hans.answerCheck: 验算：时间线圈出 12、24、36、48、60 分钟，共 5 times。

questions.question: Frederick and Justina spend $8/$16 per day, leaving Justina $70; swapping spending gives Justina $430. Find their parent-given amounts.
questions.hint: Label each money amount. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Read the two aligned case bars as equal money units: the change from the first case to the second leaves 3 equal units between $70 and $430.

steps.title: Compare the two case bars
steps.text: The top bar shows Frederick:Justina = 1:2 and the lower bar shows 2:1. Matching the fixed end segment of $70 to the $430 comparison leaves 3 equal unit blocks.

steps.title: Value one unit
steps.text: The 3 blocks represent $430 − $70 = $360, so 1 unit is $360 ÷ 3 = $120.

steps.title: Read each amount from the bars
steps.text: Frederick has 2 units, or 2 × $120 = $240. Justina has the $430 segment plus 1 unit, or $430 + $120 = $550.

en.answerCheck: Check: the 3-unit gap is 3 × $120 = $360 = $430 − $70. Answer: Frederick: $240; Justina: $550.

zh-Hans.strategy: 把两行对齐的情况条看成等额单位：从第1种情况到第2种情况，$70与$430之间相差3个等份。

steps.title: 比较两种情况条
steps.text: 上条表示 Frederick:Justina = 1:2，下条表示 2:1。把固定的$70末段与$430的比较对齐后，剩下3个相等小格。

questions.question: Tank A:B water was 4:3. Adding 0.8 L filled A, making A 2 times B. A capacity was 1/4 of B capacity. How much more water fills B?
questions.hint: Label the given measures. Draw a model, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Use the segmented tank bars: A has 6 equal units when full, and its final 2-unit segment is 0.8 L.

steps.title: Label the equal units in tank A
steps.text: The 2 shaded units added to A are 0.8 L, so 1 unit is 0.8 ÷ 2 = 0.4 L. All 6 units in full tank A are 6 × 0.4 = 2.4 L.

steps.title: Scale to tank B
steps.text: The capacity bar for B has 4 quarters, with A's 2.4 L as 1 quarter. So B holds 4 × 2.4 = 9.6 L, while its 3 water units are 3 × 0.4 = 1.2 L.

steps.title: Use B's unshaded part
steps.text: The unshaded amount needed to fill B is 9.6 − 1.2 = 8.4 L.

en.answerCheck: Check: B has 1.2 L of its 9.6 L capacity, leaving 8.4 L. Answer: 8.4 L.

zh-Hans.strategy: 使用分格水箱条：A装满时有6个等份，而A最后增加的2份是0.8 L。

steps.title: 标出A的等份
steps.text: A增加的2个阴影格是0.8 L，所以1格是0.8 ÷ 2 = 0.4 L。装满的A有6格，即6 × 0.4 = 2.4 L。

steps.title: 按比例求B
steps.text: B的容量条分成4个四分之一，其中1份等于A的2.4 L。因此B容量为4 × 2.4 = 9.6 L；B已有的3个水量格为3 × 0.4 = 1.2 L。

steps.title: 读出B的留白部分
steps.text: 填满B所需的留白量是9.6 − 1.2 = 8.4 L。

zh-Hans.answerCheck: 检验：B已有1.2 L，容量是9.6 L，剩下8.4 L。答案：8.4 L。

questions.question: Germaine spent $70 and had 2 times Gilbert. Gilbert received $300 and had 3 times Germaine’s original amount. Find their final total.
questions.hint: Label each money amount. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Follow the equal-part money bars: first remove the three fixed $70 blocks, then value the remaining equal blocks.

steps.title: Remove the fixed $70 blocks
steps.text: The diagram groups three $70 blocks, worth 3 × $70 = $210. Removing them from $300 leaves $300 − $210 = $90 across 5 equal unit blocks.

steps.title: Find one unit
steps.text: Each unit block is $90 ÷ 5 = $18.

steps.title: Add the blocks shown for the final total
steps.text: The final bar has 8 equal units and the $210 fixed amount, so its total is 8 × $18 + $210 = $354.

zh-Hans.strategy: 按等份金额条进行：先去掉3个固定的$70格，再求余下等格的金额。

steps.title: 去掉固定的$70格
steps.text: 图中把3个$70格合在一起，金额为3 × $70 = $210。从$300中去掉它们，余下$300 − $210 = $90，对应5个等格。

steps.title: 加上最后条形图的各部分
steps.text: 最后的条有8个等格和$210固定金额，所以总数是8 × $18 + $210 = $354。

questions.question: 3 books + 2 magazines cost $84; 3 comics + 2 magazines cost $54; 2 comics + 2 books cost $52. Find 1 magazine cost.
questions.hint: Label each money amount. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Rearrange the book, magazine, and comic cells exactly as the visual does so that the book-and-comic cells form one matched group.

steps.title: Make the matched book-and-comic group
steps.text: Using the visual model above, The rearranged strips show 3 books plus 3 comics as a group worth $78.

steps.title: Leave only the magazine cells
steps.text: After that group is matched, the 4 magazine cells under the $84-and-$54 strips are worth $60.

steps.title: Share the magazine total equally
steps.text: Each of the 4 identical magazine cells costs $60 ÷ 4 = $15.

en.answerCheck: Check: 4 magazine cells at $15 make $60. Answer: $15.

zh-Hans.strategy: 按图把书、杂志和漫画的格子重新排列，使书格和漫画格组成一个可配对的整体。

steps.title: 组成书和漫画的配对组
steps.text: 重排后的条形图显示3本书加3本漫画书是一组，价值$78。

steps.title: 留下杂志格
steps.text: 配对该组后，$84和$54条中余下的4个杂志格共值$60。

steps.title: 平均分杂志总价
steps.text: 4个相同杂志格的单价是$60 ÷ 4 = $15。

zh-Hans.answerCheck: 检验：4个杂志格每个$15，共为$60。答案：$15。

questions.question: 2 concentric circles have radii 7 cm and 21 cm. Shaded:unshaded area is 2:7. Find unshaded area using π = 22/7.
questions.hint: Label the given measures. Draw a model, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Use the concentric-circle partition to find the 2 shaded area units first, then scale the 7 unshaded units.

steps.title: Find the ring shown as shaded
steps.text: Large-circle area = 22/7 × 21 × 21 = 1386 cm² and small-circle area = 22/7 × 7 × 7 = 154 cm². The shaded ring is 1386 − 154 = 1232 cm².

steps.title: Value the ratio strip
steps.text: The ring is 2 equal area units in the 2:7 strip, so 1 unit is 1232 ÷ 2 = 616 cm².

steps.title: Read the 7 unshaded units
steps.text: The unshaded portion is 7 × 616 = 4312 cm².

en.answerCheck: Check: 1232:4312 = 2:7 after dividing both terms by 616. Answer: 4312 cm².

zh-Hans.strategy: 先用同心圆分区求2个阴影面积单位，再放大到7个非阴影单位。

steps.title: 确定比条的每1份
steps.text: 圆环对应2:7面积比条中的2份，所以1份是1232 ÷ 2 = 616 cm²。

steps.title: 读出7个非阴影份
steps.text: 非阴影部分是7 × 616 = 4312 cm²。

questions.question: A 12 cm × 15 cm × 30 cm container became 2/3 full; added tub water left 20% of tub’s original volume. Tub base was 24 cm × 15 cm. Find original water level.
questions.hint: Label the given measures. Draw a model, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Read the prism and 80% tub bar in sequence: the final third of the container is the transferred 80% of the tub water.

steps.title: Find the shaded third of the prism
steps.text: Using the visual model above, The container capacity is 12 × 15 × 30 = 5400 cm³. Its 1 of 3 equal volume slices is 5400 ÷ 3 = 1800 cm³.

steps.title: Complete the 80% capacity bar
steps.text: The 1800 cm³ slice is 80% of the tub's original water, so the full tub-water amount is 1800 ÷ 80 × 100 = 2250 cm³.

steps.title: Convert volume to height
steps.text: The tub base is 24 × 15 = 360 cm². Its original water height is 2250 ÷ 360 = 6.25 cm.

en.answerCheck: Check: 80% of 2250 cm³ is 1800 cm³. Answer: 6.25 cm.

zh-Hans.strategy: 依次读长方体和80%水槽条：容器最后的1/3正是水槽原有水量的80%。

steps.title: 求长方体的1/3
steps.text: 结合上面的图示模型，容器容量为12 × 15 × 30 = 5400 cm³。3个等体积块中的1块为5400 ÷ 3 = 1800 cm³。

steps.title: 补全80%容量条
steps.text: 1800 cm³是水槽原有水量的80%，所以原有水量为1800 ÷ 80 × 100 = 2250 cm³。

steps.title: 把体积换成水深
steps.text: 水槽底面积是24 × 15 = 360 cm²。原来水深为2250 ÷ 360 = 6.25 cm。

zh-Hans.answerCheck: 检验：2250 cm³的80%是1800 cm³。答案：6.25 cm。

questions.question: 6 similar rectangles form figure A and are rearranged to figure B. Figure A area is 864 cm². Find figure B perimeter.
questions.hint: Label the given measures. Draw a model, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Use the six equal rectangles to label the 6 cm and 24 cm modules, then follow every exposed edge of the stepped outline.

steps.title: Find the rectangle module
steps.text: Six equal rectangles make 864 cm², so each has area 864 ÷ 6 = 144 cm². The top rectangle is 4 equal squares, so each square is 144 ÷ 4 = 36 cm² and has side 6 cm; its length is 4 × 6 = 24 cm.

steps.title: Transfer the labels to figure B
steps.text: Mark every strip thickness as 6 cm, the short step as 12 cm, and the long edges as 24 cm, exactly as on the stepped diagram.

steps.title: Trace the outside only
steps.text: Follow the directional perimeter trace around every exposed edge of figure B. The labelled outside-edge sum shown by the trace is 156 cm.

en.answerCheck: Check: each module rectangle is 24 cm × 6 cm = 144 cm², and 6 such rectangles make 864 cm². Answer: 156 cm.

zh-Hans.strategy: 先用6个全等长方形标出6 cm和24 cm的模块，再沿阶梯图的全部外露边追踪。

steps.title: 求长方形模块
steps.text: 6个全等长方形面积共864 cm²，所以每个面积为864 ÷ 6 = 144 cm²。最上方长方形分成4个相等正方形，每个面积144 ÷ 4 = 36 cm²，边长为6 cm；长为4 × 6 = 24 cm。

steps.title: 把标注移到图形B
steps.text: 按阶梯图把所有条带厚度标为6 cm，短台阶标为12 cm，长边标为24 cm。

steps.title: 只沿外边界追踪
steps.text: 沿图形B的每一段外露边按箭头追踪。图上标出的外周长加和为156 cm。

zh-Hans.answerCheck: 检验：每个模块长方形为24 cm × 6 cm = 144 cm²，6个共864 cm²。答案：156 cm。

questions.question: A fruiterer sold 30% more apples than oranges and 10% more pears; 104 apples. Bags and prices were 4/$6, 8/$10, 2/$3. Find total sales.
questions.hint: Label each money amount. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Use the 100%, 110%, and 130% offset bars to obtain fruit counts, then read the matching unit-price table.

steps.title: Value the percentage bar
steps.text: The apple bar is 130% and is labelled 104, so 1% = 104 ÷ 130 = 0.8. Thus oranges at 100% are 80 and pears at 110% are 88.

steps.title: Use each table row
steps.text: Apples: 104 ÷ 4 bags × $6 = $156; oranges: 80 ÷ 2 bags × $3 = $120; pears: 88 ÷ 8 bags × $10 = $110.

en.answerCheck: Check: 104 is 130% of 80, and the three receipt rows total $386. Answer: $386.

zh-Hans.strategy: 用100%、110%和130%的错位百分比条求水果数量，再读对应的单价表。

steps.title: 确定百分比条的每1%

questions.hint: Label each money amount. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Follow the ruled elimination table: scale rows until matching fruit columns can be subtracted.

steps.title: Create the first reduced row
steps.text: Using the visual model above, Multiply 4O + 3A + 2P = $15.50 by 3: 12O + 9A + 6P = $46.50. Subtract 2O + 6P = $28.60 to obtain 10O + 9A = $17.90.

steps.title: Isolate apples in the table
steps.text: Multiply the reduced row by 3 to get 30O + 27A = $53.70. Multiply 3O + 4A = $6.80 by 10 to get 30O + 40A = $68. Subtract to get 13A = $14.30, so A = $1.10.

questions.question: A tap fills at 3 L/min and a hole drains 0.5 L/min. Starting 7:00 am, find pail water at 9:30 am and time to reach 10 L.
questions.hint: Label the given measures. Draw a model, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Read the rate card first, then apply its net rate to the labelled 150-minute timeline and the 10 L mini-ratio.

steps.title: Find the net rate
steps.text: The rate card gives 3 L/min − 0.5 L/min = 2.5 L/min.

steps.title: Use the timeline
steps.text: From 7:00 am to 9:30 am is 2 h 30 min = 150 min. The timeline volume is 2.5 × 150 = 375 L.

steps.title: Use the 10 L ratio
steps.text: At 2.5 L each minute, 10 L takes 10 ÷ 2.5 = 4 minutes.

en.answerCheck: Check: 2.5 × 150 = 375 L and 2.5 × 4 = 10 L. Answer: (a) 375 L; (b) 4 minutes.

zh-Hans.strategy: 先读净流量卡，再把该速率用在标有150 min的时间线和10 L小比例上。

steps.title: 求净流量
steps.text: 流量卡给出3 L/min − 0.5 L/min = 2.5 L/min。

steps.title: 使用时间线
steps.text: 从7:00 am到9:30 am是2 h 30 min = 150 min。时间线对应水量为2.5 × 150 = 375 L。

steps.title: 使用10 L比例
steps.text: 每分钟增加2.5 L，达到10 L需10 ÷ 2.5 = 4 minutes。

questions.question: Orange juice was split A/B/C. 20 ml moved B→C, 210 ml C→A, 150 ml removed A. Final A was 3 times initial A; B=C=3 times final A. Find initial amounts and carton total.
questions.answer: A: 30 ml; B: 290 ml; C: 460 ml; total: 780 ml
questions.hint: Underline the given values. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Read the transfer bars from A's two-unit difference, then use the labelled B and C transfer segments to rebuild the starting volumes.

steps.title: Value A's unit
steps.text: The two-unit difference on A is 210 ml − 150 ml = 60 ml. Therefore 1 unit, A's starting amount, is 60 ÷ 2 = 30 ml.

steps.title: Build B from three A-units
steps.text: B has 3 times final A, shown as 3 × 90 ml = 270 ml, plus the 20 ml sent to C. Thus B initially had 270 + 20 = 290 ml.

steps.title: Undo C's displayed transfers
steps.text: C starts with the 270 ml from B, the 210 ml transfer to A, and the 20 ml adjustment: 270 + 210 − 20 = 460 ml. Total initial juice is 30 + 290 + 460 = 780 ml.

zh-Hans.strategy: 先从A的2份差读出单位量，再利用B和C条上的转移段还原最初体积。

steps.title: 求A的每1份
steps.text: A上的2份差为210 ml − 150 ml = 60 ml。因此1份，即A最初的量，是60 ÷ 2 = 30 ml。

steps.title: 用3个A单位组成B
steps.text: B是最后A的3倍，图上为3 × 90 ml = 270 ml，再加上移到C的20 ml。因此B最初有270 + 20 = 290 ml。

steps.title: 倒推C的转移段
steps.text: C的最初量由来自B的270 ml、转给A的210 ml和20 ml调整段组成：270 + 210 − 20 = 460 ml。最初总量为30 + 290 + 460 = 780 ml。

questions.question: Joanne gave 1/3 to her mother then saved:spent 1:2. Alex spent 1/4 clothes and 1/4 books; Joanne’s gift equalled Alex’s books. Her $180 transfer leaves 1/4 of Alex’s savings. Find requested values.
questions.hint: Label each money amount. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Count the categorised equal cells in the two money bars, using the bracketed $180 as one unit.

steps.title: Read the two starting bars
steps.text: Joanne's bar contains 8 equal $180 cells, so she starts with 8 × $180 = $1440. Alex's bar contains 6 equal $180 cells, so he starts with 6 × $180 = $1080.

steps.title: Count the spent cells
steps.text: The cells marked spent across the two bars total 7 equal units.

steps.title: Convert the spent units to money
steps.text: Their total spending is 7 × $180 = $1260.

en.answerCheck: Check: 8 units give $1440, 6 units give $1080, and 7 spent units give $1260. Answer: (a) Joanne: $1440; Alex: $1080; (b) $1260.

zh-Hans.strategy: 数两条金额条中分类的等格，并把括号标出的$180作为1份。

steps.title: 读出两条起始金额条
steps.text: Joanne 的条有8个每格$180的等格，所以起初有8 × $180 = $1440。Alex 的条有6个等格，所以起初有6 × $180 = $1080。

steps.title: 数花费格
steps.text: 两条中标为spent的格合计7个等份。

questions.question: 2 taps add 6 L/min each while a hole drains 8 L per 4 min. A tank is 40% full after 10 min. Find capacity and extra fill time.
questions.hint: Label the given measures. Draw a model, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Use the inflow/outflow rate table, then read 100 L as the 4 shaded blocks of the 10-block capacity bar.

steps.title: Complete the rate table
steps.text: Using the visual model above, Entering water is 2 × 6 = 12 L/min. Leaving water is 8 ÷ 4 = 2 L/min. The net row is 12 − 2 = 10 L/min.

steps.title: Value the 40% tank bar
steps.text: In 10 minutes the tank gains 10 × 10 = 100 L. The 4 shaded blocks are 40%, so the 10-block full capacity is 100 ÷ 40 × 100 = 250 L.

steps.title: Fill the 6 unshaded blocks
steps.text: The remaining 6 blocks are 250 − 100 = 150 L, which takes 150 ÷ 10 = 15 minutes.

questions.question: Mary had $50, Tom $130. Their mother gave equal daily amounts; after 2 days Mary had 2 times Tom. Find total given and Mary’s daily amount.
questions.hint: Label each money amount. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Use the two aligned money bars: Mary's 2 units and Tom's 3 units differ by one unit, the original $80 gap.

steps.title: Value the extra unit
steps.text: Tom's starting amount exceeds Mary's by $130 − $50 = $80. The extra third block in Tom's bar is therefore $80.

steps.title: Read Mary's two blocks
steps.text: Mary's final bar has 2 equal blocks, so it is 2 × $80 = $160. The two-day amount she received is $160 − $50 = $110.

steps.title: Split the two-day amount
steps.text: Both received the same $110 over 2 days, so the mother gave $110 + $110 = $220 in total and Mary received $110 ÷ 2 = $55 each day.

en.answerCheck: Check: Mary receives $110 and Tom receives $110, for $220; $110 over 2 days is $55 per day. Answer: (a) $220; (b) $55.

zh-Hans.strategy: 使用两条对齐金额条：Mary有2份，Tom有3份，多出的1份就是起初的$80差额。

steps.title: 确定多出的1份
steps.text: Tom起初比Mary多$130 − $50 = $80，因此Tom条上多出的第3格是$80。

steps.title: 读出Mary的2格
steps.text: Mary最后的条有2个等格，所以是2 × $80 = $160。她2天收到的钱是$160 − $50 = $110。

steps.title: 把2天金额平分
steps.text: 两人2天各收到相同的$110，因此母亲共给$110 + $110 = $220，Mary每天收到$110 ÷ 2 = $55。

questions.question: Square perimeters A:B were 3:5, shaded-rectangle perimeter:A was 2:6, and square perimeters totalled 192 cm. Find 3 requested areas.
questions.hint: Label the given measures. Draw a model, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Use the two perimeter-ratio strips to label both squares and their shared shaded rectangle before subtracting the shaded area.

steps.title: Find the square sides from the first ratio strip
steps.text: A:B = 3:5, so 8 units = 192 cm and 1 unit = 24 cm. The square perimeters are 72 cm and 120 cm, giving sides 18 cm and 30 cm.

steps.title: Find the common rectangle
steps.text: The rectangle:A perimeter ratio is 2:6, so its perimeter is 2/6 × 72 = 24 cm. Its length is 18 ÷ 2 = 9 cm and breadth is (24 − 9 − 9) ÷ 2 = 3 cm, so its area is 27 cm².

en.answerCheck: Check: the common rectangle is 9 cm × 3 cm = 27 cm². Answer: (a) 27 cm²; (b) 873 cm²; (c) 1170 cm².

zh-Hans.strategy: 先用2条周长比条标出两个正方形和共同的阴影长方形，再减去阴影面积。

steps.title: 由第1条比条求正方形边长
steps.text: 结合上面的图示模型，A:B = 3:5，所以8份 = 192 cm，1份 = 24 cm。两个正方形周长为72 cm和120 cm，边长为18 cm和30 cm。

steps.title: 求共同长方形
steps.text: 长方形:A周长比为2:6，所以长方形周长是2/6 × 72 = 24 cm。长为18 ÷ 2 = 9 cm，宽为(24 − 9 − 9) ÷ 2 = 3 cm，面积为27 cm²。

zh-Hans.answerCheck: 检验：共同长方形为9 cm × 3 cm = 27 cm²。答案：(a) 27 cm²; (b) 873 cm²; (c) 1170 cm²。

questions.question: A rectangle contains 2 quadrants of radii 12 cm and 24 cm. Find the difference in shaded areas using π = 3.14.
questions.hint: Label the given measures. Draw a model, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Read the composite diagram as one large quadrant with the small quadrant and rectangle removed.

steps.title: Calculate the two quadrant areas
steps.text: Using the visual model above, Small quadrant = 1/4 × 3.14 × 12 × 12 = 113.04 cm². Large quadrant = 1/4 × 3.14 × 24 × 24 = 452.16 cm².

steps.title: Calculate the rectangle area
steps.text: The labelled rectangle is 12 × 24 = 288 cm².

steps.title: Use the area ledger
steps.text: The residual shaded area is 452.16 − 113.04 − 288 = 51.12 cm².

steps.title: 计算2个四分之一圆面积

questions.question: Basins A, B, C are identical. A has mass 3.1 kg at 1/2 full and B 2.2 kg at 1/5 full. Find C’s filled fraction when it has mass 2.8 kg.
questions.hint: Label the given measures. Draw a model, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Use the aligned mass bars to find the empty-basin mass, then read basin C as 4 shaded cells of a 10-cell fill bar.

steps.title: Value one water-mass unit
steps.text: Using the visual model above, A exceeds B by 3 equal cells, while 3.1 kg − 2.2 kg = 0.9 kg. Thus 1 cell represents 0.9 ÷ 3 = 0.3 kg.

steps.title: Remove the common basin mass
steps.text: B's 2 water cells weigh 2 × 0.3 = 0.6 kg, so the empty basin weighs 2.2 − 0.6 = 1.6 kg. C's water weighs 2.8 − 1.6 = 1.2 kg = 4 cells.

steps.title: Read the fill bar
steps.text: The visual shades 4 of 10 equal fill cells, so its displayed fraction is 4/10 = 2/5.

en.answerCheck: Check: 4 of 10 equal fill units is 4/10 = 2/5. Answer: 2/5.

zh-Hans.strategy: 用对齐质量条求空盆质量，再把C读成10格装水条中的4个阴影格。

steps.title: 确定每个水量格的质量
steps.text: A比B多3个等格，而3.1 kg − 2.2 kg = 0.9 kg。因此1格代表0.9 ÷ 3 = 0.3 kg。

steps.title: 读出装水条
steps.text: 图中10个等格有4格阴影，所以图示分数为4/10 = 2/5。

zh-Hans.answerCheck: 检验：10个相等单位中的4个是4/10 = 2/5。答案：2/5。

questions.question: A 20 cm × 12 cm × 15 cm tank had water. After 1/10 was poured into a tub, tub volume increased 12 cm³. What fraction of tank capacity was unfilled at first?
questions.hint: Label the given measures. Draw a model, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Read the 10 equal water units and the capacity box together.

steps.title: Value the 10-unit water strip
steps.text: The highlighted 1/10 unit is 12 cm³. Therefore all 10 equal units show 10 × 12 = 120 cm³ of water at first.

steps.title: Read the tank-capacity box
steps.text: The rectangular prism is 20 cm × 12 cm × 15 cm, so its capacity is 20 × 12 × 15 = 3600 cm³.

steps.title: Compare the two volumes
steps.text: The unfilled volume is 3600 − 120 = 3480 cm³. The diagram’s remainder is 3480/3600 = 29/30 of the tank.

steps.title: 计算水箱容量
steps.text: 长方体的尺寸是20 cm × 12 cm × 15 cm，所以容量为20 × 12 × 15 = 3600 cm³。

questions.question: Mathew sold 1/3 of pens on day 1, 4 more on day 2, then the rest day 3. Day 2 exceeded day 3 by 15. Find original pens.
questions.hint: Underline the given values. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Use the 12-cell chronological bar to turn every day into equal units.

steps.title: Label the three parts of the bar
steps.text: The bar shows first day as 1/4 = 3/12, second day as 1/3 + 1/4 = 7/12, and the third day as 12/12 − 3/12 − 7/12 = 2/12.

steps.title: Use the bracketed difference
steps.text: The second-day section has 7 units and the third-day section has 2 units, so their difference is 5 units. The bracket says these 5 units are 15 pens.

steps.title: Scale the full bar
steps.text: One unit is 15 ÷ 5 = 3 pens. All 12 units are 12 × 3 = 36 pens.

steps.title: 利用括号标出的差
steps.text: 第二天有7格，第三天有2格，相差5格。括号说明这5格等于15支笔。

questions.question: Edmund bought small $4, medium $6, large $8 cookie packs. 1/4 were small, medium exceeded small by 4, total was $180. Find each pack count.
questions.hint: Label each money amount. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Use the 15-unit purchase bar, then convert each coloured section from dollars to packs.

steps.title: Build the 15-unit bar
steps.text: Small packs are 1/3 = 5/15. Medium packs are 1/5 + 5/15 = 8/15, leaving 15 − 5 − 8 = 2 units for large packs.

steps.title: Value one bar unit
steps.text: The complete 15-unit bar costs $180, so 1 unit costs $180 ÷ 15 = $12.

zh-Hans.strategy: 用15格购买组成条，再把每种颜色的金额换成包数。
zh-Hans.answerCheck: 小包装15包；中包装16包；大包装3包。

questions.question: Ben and Tom had 144 sweets. Ben gave Tom 1/4 of his; Tom gave Ben 1/3 of his; they then matched. Find original counts.
questions.hint: Underline the given values. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Work backward with the two transfer bars, starting from the equal final shares.

steps.title: Read the equal final share
steps.text: The statement above both bars gives 144 ÷ 2 = 72 sweets each at the end.

steps.title: Value the upper transfer bar
steps.text: Tom’s upper bar has 3 units bracketed as 72 after giving to Ben. Thus 1 unit is 72 ÷ 3 = 24, and the 4 shown units total 4 × 24 = 96.

steps.title: Use the lower transfer bar
steps.text: The remaining amount shown for Ben is 144 − 96 = 48. Ben’s lower bar has 4 units equal to 48, so 1 unit is 48 ÷ 4 = 12 and 5 units are 5 × 12 = 60. The total then gives Tom 144 − 60 = 84.

zh-Hans.strategy: 从最后相等的数量出发，用两条转移条倒推。

steps.title: 读出最后相等的份数
steps.text: 两条长条上方给出最后各有144 ÷ 2 = 72颗糖。

steps.title: 确定上方转移条每格的数值
steps.text: Tom上方的条中，括起来的3格是给Ben后剩下的72。因此1格是72 ÷ 3 = 24，图中4格合共是4 × 24 = 96。

steps.title: 使用下方转移条
steps.text: Ben图中剩下的数量为144 − 96 = 48。Ben下方的4格等于48，所以1格是48 ÷ 4 = 12，5格是5 × 12 = 60。总数为144，所以Tom有144 − 60 = 84。

questions.question: Claudia gave Agnes 1/4 of her curry puffs; Agnes gave Claudia 1/3 of hers. They then matched and had 240 total. Find original counts.
questions.hint: Underline the given values. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Use the publisher’s two aligned transfer rows as one 20-unit total.

steps.title: Read the aligned rows
steps.text: Claudia’s row has 12 equal units and Agnes’s row has 8 equal units. Together the model has 20 units for 240 curry puffs; the transfer marks show 1/4 = 3/12.

steps.title: Find one unit
steps.text: Each equal unit is 240 ÷ 20 = 12 curry puffs.

steps.title: Scale each original row
steps.text: Claudia’s 12 units are 12 × 12 = 144 curry puffs. Agnes’s 8 units are 8 × 12 = 96 curry puffs.

zh-Hans.strategy: 把原解答中两条对齐的转移条看成合共20格。

steps.title: 读出两条对齐长条
steps.text: Claudia的条有12个等格，Agnes的条有8个等格。模型一共有20格，对应240个咖喱角；转移标记说明1/4 = 3/12。

steps.title: 求每格数量
steps.text: 每个等格是240 ÷ 20 = 12个咖喱角。

steps.title: 计算两人的原有数量
steps.text: Claudia的12格是12 × 12 = 144个。Agnes的8格是8 × 12 = 96个。

questions.question: A florist sold 1/5 of orchids and 1/3 of roses, leaving 60. After 14 more roses sold, 1/2 of original roses remained. Find original fruit total.
questions.hint: Underline the given values. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Follow the 15-part roses bar, then the 5-part orchids remainder bar.

steps.title: Value the roses bar
steps.text: In the 15-part bar, 1/3 = 5/15 were sold yesterday, 7 units are the later 14 roses sold, and 1/5 = 3/15 are left. Thus 1 unit is 14 ÷ 7 = 2 roses and the full bar is 15 × 2 = 30 roses.

steps.title: Find the flowers left after the first sale
steps.text: The roses remaining then are 10 units, or 10 × 2 = 20. Of the 60 flowers left, the orchids remaining are 60 − 20 = 40.

steps.title: Use the orchids bar
steps.text: The orchids bar has 4 left units after 1/5 was sold. Therefore 1 unit is 40 ÷ 4 = 10 and all 5 units are 5 × 10 = 50 orchids. The original total is 50 + 30 = 80.

zh-Hans.strategy: 先读15格玫瑰条，再读5格兰花剩余条。

steps.title: 确定玫瑰条每格的数值
求第一次卖出后剩下的花
steps.text: 当时剩下的玫瑰有10格，即10 × 2 = 20朵。总共剩60朵，所以剩下的兰花有60 − 20 = 40朵。

steps.title: 使用兰花条
steps.text: 兰花条中卖出1/5后还剩4格。因此1格是40 ÷ 4 = 10朵，5格共有5 × 10 = 50朵兰花。原有总数为50 + 30 = 80。

zh-Hans.answerCheck: 兰花和玫瑰原来共有80朵。

questions.question: Of Chinese, English, Malay books, 1/4 were Chinese and 1/3 of the remainder English. Malay exceeded English by 63. Find each count.
questions.hint: Underline the given values. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Partition the whole into the 20 equal book parts shown by the bar.

steps.title: Label the three sections
steps.text: Using the visual model above, Chinese books are 1/4 = 5/20. English books are 1/5 of the remaining 3/4, so they are 1/5 × 3/4 = 3/20. The remaining Malay section is 20 − 5 − 3 = 12 parts.

steps.title: Use the bracketed difference
steps.text: Malay has 12 parts and English has 3 parts, so the marked difference is 9 parts = 63 books.

steps.title: Scale every section
steps.text: One part is 63 ÷ 9 = 7 books. Chinese: 5 × 7 = 35; English: 3 × 7 = 21; Malay: 12 × 7 = 84.

zh-Hans.strategy: 把图书总数按长条分成20个等份。

steps.title: 标出3个部分
steps.text: 结合上面的图示模型，中文书占1/4 = 5/20。英文书占余下3/4的1/5，即1/5 × 3/4 = 3/20。马来文书是剩下的20 − 5 − 3 = 12格。

questions.question: After selling 1/3 of apples and 7 pears, pears left were 1/4 apples left. Pears sold were 1/7 pears not sold. Find original fruit counts.
questions.hint: Underline the given values. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Link the 7-part pears bar to the 6-part apples bar.

steps.title: Read the pears bar
steps.text: The pears bar has 1 sold unit labelled 7 and 6 not-sold units. Thus the not-sold pears are 6 × 7 = 42 and all 7 units give 7 × 7 = 49 pears.

steps.title: Link the two remainders
steps.text: The diagram states that the 42 pears left are 1/4 of the apples left. Hence the apples-left section is 4 × 42 = 168.

steps.title: Complete the apples bar
steps.text: The apples bar represents 1/3 sold as 2 of 6 units and 4 units not sold. Each unit is 42, so all 6 units are 6 × 42 = 252 apples.

zh-Hans.strategy: 把7格梨条与6格苹果条的剩余部分连起来。

steps.title: 读出梨条
steps.text: 梨条中卖出的1格标为7，未卖出的有6格。因此剩下的梨是6 × 7 = 42个，7格总数是7 × 7 = 49个。

steps.title: 连接两个剩余部分
steps.text: 图中说明剩下的42个梨是剩下苹果的1/4。因此剩下的苹果部分是4 × 42 = 168个。

steps.title: 完成苹果条
steps.text: 苹果条把卖出的1/3表示为6格中的2格，未卖出的是4格。每格是42个，所以6格共有6 × 42 = 252个苹果。

questions.questionZh: 卖出苹果的1/3和7个梨后，剩下的梨是剩下苹果的1/4。卖出的梨是未卖出梨的1/7。求原来苹果和梨各有多少个。

questions.question: 1/4 of Mr Jones’s notes were $2; 2/3 of the rest were $10; remaining were $5. Total was $295. How many $10 notes?
questions.hint: Label each money amount. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Use the repeating 10-note denomination strip as one complete set.

steps.title: Read one note set
steps.text: The strip contains two $2 notes, three $10 notes, and five $5 notes: 10 notes in one set.

steps.title: Find the value and number of sets
steps.text: One set is (2 × $2) + (3 × $10) + (5 × $5) = $59. Therefore $295 ÷ $59 = 5 identical sets.

steps.title: Count the highlighted notes
steps.text: Each set has 3 ten-dollar notes, so 5 sets have 5 × 3 = 15 ten-dollar notes.

zh-Hans.strategy: 把重复的10格钞票条看成1个完整组合。

steps.title: 读出1组钞票
steps.text: 这条中有2张$2、3张$10和5张$5纸币，合共10张。

steps.title: 数出突出显示的纸币
steps.text: 每组有3张$10纸币，所以5组有5 × 3 = 15张$10纸币。

questions.question: Jim and Alice had marbles. 1/4 of Jim’s count was 1/3 of Alice’s. Jim gave Alice 30; Alice was then 40 ahead; Jim had 2/3 left. Find original counts.
questions.hint: Underline the given values. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Compare the before-and-after marble bars to value one equal unit.

steps.title: Read the two states
steps.text: Before the transfer, the aligned bars show Jim : Alice = 4 : 3. After the transfer, Jim has 5 units and Alice has 6 original units plus 3 transferred units, or 9 units; the gap is 4 units = 40.

steps.title: Value one unit
steps.text: The transfer bracket marks 3 units = 30 marbles, so 1 unit = 30 ÷ 3 = 10 marbles.

steps.title: Return to the original bars
steps.text: Jim’s original bar is 8 units, so 8 × 10 = 80 marbles. Alice’s original bar is 6 units, so 6 × 10 = 60 marbles.

zh-Hans.strategy: 比较转移前和转移后的弹珠条，确定每个等格的数值。

steps.title: 读出两个状态
steps.text: 转移前，对齐长条表示Jim : Alice = 4 : 3。转移后，Jim有5格；Alice有6格原有部分加3格转入部分，共9格；相差4格 = 40。

steps.title: 确定每格数量
steps.text: 转移括号标出3格 = 30个弹珠，所以1格 = 30 ÷ 3 = 10个。

steps.title: 回到原有的长条
steps.text: Jim原有的条是8格，所以有8 × 10 = 80个弹珠。Alice原有的条是6格，所以有6 × 10 = 60个弹珠。

questions.question: Francis had $3.60 in $0.05 and $0.20 coins. 1/4 of coins were $0.20 coins. Find each coin count.
questions.hint: Label each money amount. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Use the count-ratio bar to restrict the coin counts, then follow the two-row check table.

steps.title: Read the count relationship
steps.text: The five-part count bar shows the twenty-cent count is twice the five-cent count. Since $3.60 is 360¢, the five-cent count must be even.

steps.title: Test the first table row
steps.text: For 12 twenty-cent coins and 6 five-cent coins, (12 × 20¢) + (6 × 5¢) = $2.70, so this row is not the $3.60 total.

steps.title: Use the checked row
steps.text: For 16 twenty-cent coins and 8 five-cent coins, (16 × 20¢) + (8 × 5¢) = $3.60. This is the row with the check mark.

steps.title: 读出数量关系

questions.question: Cars P, Q, R were 300 km apart at 8:30 am. Q met P at 11:30 am and R 30 min later; P drove 60 km/h. How far did Q travel between meetings?
questions.hint: Underline the given values. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Use the shared 3-hour route interval to find Q’s speed, then extend Q’s timeline by 0.5 hour.

steps.title: Read the first time band
steps.text: From 8:30 am to 11:30 am is 3 hours. On the route line, P covers 60 × 3 = 180 km of the 300 km separation.

steps.title: Find Q’s speed
steps.text: The remaining route segment to the same meeting point is 300 − 180 = 120 km for Q. Thus Q’s speed is 120 ÷ 3 = 40 km/h.

steps.title: Extend to Q–R’s meeting
steps.text: The timeline adds 0.5 hour before Q meets R. Q travels 40 × 0.5 = 20 km in that interval.

en.answerCheck: Q travelled 20 km between the meetings.

zh-Hans.strategy: 利用共同的3小时路线区间求Q的速度，再把Q的时间线延长0.5小时。

steps.title: 读出第1段时间带
steps.text: 从8:30 am到11:30 am是3小时。路线图中P走了60 × 3 = 180 km，占相距300 km中的一段。

steps.title: 求Q的速度
steps.text: 到同一相遇点，Q要走的另一段是300 − 180 = 120 km。因此Q的速度是120 ÷ 3 = 40 km/h。

steps.title: 延长到Q与R相遇
steps.text: 时间线在Q与R相遇前再延长0.5小时。Q在这段时间走了40 × 0.5 = 20 km。

zh-Hans.answerCheck: 两次相遇之间，Q行驶了20 km。

questions.question: Terence and Linda drove A→B at noon. Terence averaged 15 km/h faster; at 4 pm he arrived while Linda covered 224 km. Find A–B distance.
questions.hint: Underline the given values. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Let the common 4-hour timeline drive both parallel travel rows.

steps.title: Use Linda’s row
steps.text: The common timeline from 12 noon to 4 pm is 4 hours. Linda’s row gives 224 km in 4 hours, so her speed is 224 ÷ 4 = 56 km/h.

steps.title: Build Terence’s speed row
steps.text: Terence’s row is 15 km/h faster, so his speed is 56 + 15 = 71 km/h.

steps.title: Apply the same time window
steps.text: Terence reaches B in the same 4 hours, so the A–B route is 71 × 4 = 284 km.

zh-Hans.strategy: 让共同的4小时时间线带动两条平行的行程计算。

steps.title: 使用Linda的行程
steps.text: 从中午12点到下午4点的共同时间线是4小时。Linda在4小时走224 km，所以速度是224 ÷ 4 = 56 km/h。

steps.title: 组成Terence的速度行
steps.text: Terence比Linda快15 km/h，所以速度是56 + 15 = 71 km/h。

steps.title: 使用相同的时间段
steps.text: Terence也在相同的4小时内到达B，所以A到B的距离是71 × 4 = 284 km。

questions.question: Aaron drove 80 km/h from 5:30 to 11:30, 1 h 36 min late. If he travelled the initial 1/2 at 100 km/h, find needed later-part speed.
questions.hint: Underline the given values. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Split the 480-km route into two equal halves and use the expected-time strip.

steps.title: Build the route and expected-time strips
steps.text: The actual trip from 5:30 to 11:30 is 6 hours at 80 km/h, so the route is 80 × 6 = 480 km. Being 1 h 36 min late means the expected duration is 6 − 1.6 = 4.4 hours.

steps.title: Time the first 240 km
steps.text: Each half of the route is 480 ÷ 2 = 240 km. The first half at 100 km/h takes 240 ÷ 100 = 2.4 hours.

steps.title: Use the remaining time strip
steps.text: The expected-time strip has 4.4 − 2.4 = 2 hours left for the second 240 km. Its needed speed is 240 ÷ 2 = 120 km/h.

en.answerCheck: The needed later-part speed is 120 km/h.

zh-Hans.strategy: 把480 km路线分成两个相等的半程，并使用预期时间条。

steps.title: 画出路线和预期时间条
steps.text: 实际行程从5:30到11:30，共6小时，以80 km/h行驶，所以路线为80 × 6 = 480 km。迟到1 h 36 min，表示预期用时是6 − 1.6 = 4.4小时。

steps.title: 计算前240 km的用时
steps.text: 路线的每一半是480 ÷ 2 = 240 km。前半程以100 km/h行驶，需要240 ÷ 100 = 2.4小时。

steps.title: 使用时间条中剩下的时间
steps.text: 预期时间条还剩4.4 − 2.4 = 2小时给后240 km。因此所需速度是240 ÷ 2 = 120 km/h。

zh-Hans.answerCheck: 后半程所需速度是120 km/h。

en.strategy: Synchronize both drivers at 10:30, then compare their route distances.

steps.title: Read Tony’s timeline
steps.text: The clock line places Tony’s start at 6:30 am and his arrival at 10:30 am: 4 hours. His speed is 90 − 10 = 80 km/h, so A–B is 80 × 4 = 320 km.

steps.title: Read Jasper’s shorter timeline
steps.text: Jasper starts at 8:30 am, so by 10:30 am he has driven 2 hours at 90 km/h. His shaded route section is 90 × 2 = 180 km.

steps.title: Find the unshaded route remainder
steps.text: The remaining distance to B is 320 − 180 = 140 km.

zh-Hans.strategy: 把两人的时间线同步到10:30，再比较路线距离。

steps.title: 读出Tony的时间线

steps.title: 读出Jasper较短的时间线

steps.title: 求未涂出的路线余段
steps.text: 到B的剩余距离是320 − 180 = 140 km。

questions.question: George jogged 9 km/h from 4:15. Caleb began 4:45 and at 5:45 was 2 km ahead. If Caleb had begun at 4:15, how far would he cover?
questions.hint: Underline the given values. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Use the staggered-start timeline to compare distances at 5:45, then extend Caleb’s row.

steps.title: Read George’s full interval
steps.text: George’s timeline runs from 4:15 to 5:45, or 1.5 hours. His distance bar is 9 × 1.5 = 13.5 km.

steps.title: Find Caleb’s one-hour speed
steps.text: Caleb’s row runs only from 4:45 to 5:45, or 1 hour. At 5:45 he is 2 km farther, so his distance is 13.5 + 2 = 15.5 km and his speed is 15.5 km/h.

steps.title: Extend Caleb to the full interval
steps.text: If Caleb started at 4:15, his row would also be 1.5 hours long. He would cover 15.5 × 1.5 = 23.25 km.

questions.question: A car takes 5 h and bus 9 h for A→B; car speed is 90 km/h. After 3/5 journey, how much faster must bus travel to arrive 1 h 36 min early?
questions.hint: Underline the given values. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Use the five-part 450-km route bar and the shortened total-time strip.

steps.title: Set the route and original speed
steps.text: The car’s route is 90 × 5 = 450 km. The bus originally takes 9 hours, so its original speed is 450 ÷ 9 = 50 km/h.

steps.title: Read the first 3/5 route section
steps.text: The shaded first 3 of 5 equal parts are 3/5 × 450 = 270 km. At 50 km/h, this section takes 270 ÷ 50 = 5.4 hours.

steps.title: Use the revised time for the final 2/5
steps.text: Arriving 1 h 36 min early changes 9 hours to 9 − 1.6 = 7.4 hours. After 5.4 hours, 2 hours remain for 2/5 × 450 = 180 km, so the new speed is 180 ÷ 2 = 90 km/h. The increase is 90 − 50 = 40 km/h.

en.answerCheck: The bus must travel 40 km/h faster.

zh-Hans.strategy: 使用分成5份的450 km路线条和缩短后的总时间条。

steps.title: 确定路线和原来的速度
steps.text: 汽车的路线为90 × 5 = 450 km。巴士原来用9小时，所以原速度为450 ÷ 9 = 50 km/h。

steps.title: 读出前3/5路线段
steps.text: 涂出的前5等份中的3份是3/5 × 450 = 270 km。以50 km/h行驶，这一段需要270 ÷ 50 = 5.4小时。

steps.title: 用修订时间计算最后2/5
steps.text: 提前1 h 36 min到达，使9小时变成9 − 1.6 = 7.4小时。已用5.4小时后，剩2小时行驶2/5 × 450 = 180 km，所以新速度是180 ÷ 2 = 90 km/h。提高了90 − 50 = 40 km/h。

questions.question: Collin was 150 m ahead of Bryan; Aaron was 50 m behind Bryan. At 8:00, Aaron passed Bryan in 2 min and Collin 3 min later. Bryan ran 120 m/min. When did Bryan pass Collin?
questions.hint: Underline the given values. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Follow the position track: use the 2-minute catch-up strip for Aaron, the 5-minute strip for Collin, then close the fixed 150 m gap.

steps.title: Read the 2-minute catch-up strip
steps.text: Bryan covers 2 × 120 = 240 m. Aaron starts 50 m behind Bryan, so his aligned strip is 50 + 240 = 290 m in 2 min. Therefore Aaron runs at 290 ÷ 2 = 145 m/min.

steps.title: Read the 5-minute position strip
steps.text: In 5 min, Aaron covers 5 × 145 = 725 m. On the track, remove Collin’s 150 m head start and Aaron’s 50 m starting deficit: 725 − 150 − 50 = 525 m. Thus Collin runs at 525 ÷ 5 = 105 m/min.

steps.title: Close the last gap
steps.text: Bryan gains 120 − 105 = 15 m/min on Collin. The fixed gap is 150 m, so 150 ÷ 15 = 10 min after 8:00, which is 8:10 am.

zh-Hans.strategy: 按位置线来算：先读出 Aaron 的 2 min 追及路程，再用 5 min 路程条求 Collin 的速度，最后追完固定的 150 m 间距。

steps.title: 读出 2 min 追及路程条
steps.text: 结合上面的图示模型，Bryan 在 2 min 内跑 2 × 120 = 240 m。Aaron 起点在 Bryan 后 50 m，所以对齐后的路程是 50 + 240 = 290 m，用时 2 min。Aaron 的速度是 290 ÷ 2 = 145 m/min。

steps.title: 读出 5 min 位置路程条
steps.text: 5 min 内 Aaron 跑 5 × 145 = 725 m。按位置线扣除 Collin 的 150 m 领先距离和 Aaron 的 50 m 起点落后距离：725 − 150 − 50 = 525 m。因此 Collin 的速度是 525 ÷ 5 = 105 m/min。

steps.title: 追完最后的间距
steps.text: Bryan 每分钟追近 120 − 105 = 15 m。固定间距是 150 m，所以 150 ÷ 15 = 10 min；8:00 后 10 min 是 8:10 am。
