questions.question: Sean drove 90 km/h from 5:30 to 1:30. Mary made the same trip in 6 h. How far was Sean from the destination when they were 150 km apart?
questions.hint: Underline the given values. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Use the two aligned journey lanes to find the common 720 km route, then mark the 5-hour point where the lanes are 150 km apart.

steps.title: Label the complete lanes
steps.text: Sean’s lane runs from 5:30 am to 1:30 pm, or 8 h, at 90 km/h. The common route is 90 × 8 = 720 km. Mary’s 6-hour lane therefore has speed 720 ÷ 6 = 120 km/h.

steps.title: Locate the 150 km separation
steps.text: The aligned lanes separate at 120 − 90 = 30 km/h. A 150 km separation occurs after 150 ÷ 30 = 5 h.

steps.title: Shade Sean’s final segment
steps.text: At the 5-hour mark, Sean has 8 − 5 = 3 h left. His shaded final segment is 90 × 3 = 270 km.

zh-Hans.strategy: 用两条对齐的行程线求共同的 720 km 全程，再在 5 h 处标出两条线相距 150 km 的位置。

steps.title: 标出两条完整行程线
steps.text: Sean 的行程线从 5:30 am 到 1:30 pm，共 8 h，速度为 90 km/h。共同全程是 90 × 8 = 720 km。Mary 用 6 h 走完全程，速度为 720 ÷ 6 = 120 km/h。

steps.title: 找到相距 150 km 的时刻
steps.text: 两条对齐行程线每小时拉开 120 − 90 = 30 km。相距 150 km 需要 150 ÷ 30 = 5 h。

steps.title: 读出 Sean 的最后一段
steps.text: 在 5 h 的标记处，Sean 还剩 8 − 5 = 3 h。他到终点的阴影段是 90 × 3 = 270 km。

questions.question: Mark left P at 10:00 am at 75 km/h. Jane left P 1 hour later at 120 km/h. She passed Mark after completing 2/5 of her journey and reached Q at 4:00 pm. (a) How far was Jane from Q when she passed Mark? (b) What speed did Mark travel at after the meeting if he reached Q at 3.30 pm?
questions.hint: Underline the given values. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Partition the 600 km route bar into five equal units, then read the 2-unit meeting section and the 3-unit remaining section.

steps.title: Build the five-unit route bar
steps.text: Jane travels from 11 am to 4 pm for 5 h at 120 km/h, so P–Q is 120 × 5 = 600 km. Each of the 5 equal units is 600 ÷ 5 = 120 km; the first 2 units are 240 km and the last 3 units are 360 km.

steps.title: Mark the meeting point
steps.text: Jane reaches the 2-unit section after 240 ÷ 120 = 2 h, so she passes Mark at 1 pm. The distance from that point to Q is the remaining 3-unit section, 360 km.

steps.title: Use the final time strip
steps.text: From 1 pm to 3:30 pm is 2.5 h. Mark’s speed over the labelled 360 km section is 360 ÷ 2.5 = 144 km/h.

zh-Hans.strategy: 把 600 km 路程条分成 5 个等份，再读出会面前的 2 份和会面后的 3 份。

steps.title: 画出 5 等份路程条
steps.text: 结合上面的图示模型，Jane 从 11 am 到 4 pm 行驶 5 h，速度为 120 km/h，所以 P–Q 是 120 × 5 = 600 km。每一份为 600 ÷ 5 = 120 km；前 2 份是 240 km，后 3 份是 360 km。

steps.title: 标出会面点
steps.text: Jane 走前 2 份需要 240 ÷ 120 = 2 h，所以她在 1 pm 超过 Mark。该点到 Q 的距离是剩下的 3 份，即 360 km。

steps.title: 利用最后的时间线
steps.text: 从 1 pm 到 3:30 pm 是 2.5 h。Mark 在标出的 360 km 路段的速度是 360 ÷ 2.5 = 144 km/h。

questions.question: A 15 cm × 20 cm × 30 cm container was 1/5 full. Taps at 120 and 180 ml/min fill it. How much faster is filling if each tap flows 200 ml/min?
questions.hint: Label the given measures. Draw a model, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Use the four unfilled bands of the tank, then compare the two rows of the flow-rate table.

steps.title: Label the unfilled tank bands
steps.text: The tank capacity is 15 × 20 × 30 = 9000 cm³. It is 1/5 full, so the 4 highlighted unfilled bands total 4/5 × 9000 = 7200 cm³.

steps.title: Complete the original row
steps.text: The original taps give 120 + 180 = 300 cm³/min. The table’s first time cell is 7200 ÷ 300 = 24 min.

steps.title: Complete the revised row and compare
steps.text: The revised taps give 200 + 200 = 400 cm³/min, so the second time cell is 7200 ÷ 400 = 18 min. The arrow between the time cells shows 24 − 18 = 6 minutes faster.

zh-Hans.strategy: 先用水箱中 4 个未装满的体积分层，再比较流量表的两行。

steps.title: 标出水箱未装满的分层
steps.text: 水箱容量为 15 × 20 × 30 = 9000 cm³。它已有 1/5 满，图中突出的 4 层未装满部分是 4/5 × 9000 = 7200 cm³。

steps.title: 完成原来流量的一行
steps.text: 原来两个水龙头的合流量是 120 + 180 = 300 cm³/min。表中第一格时间为 7200 ÷ 300 = 24 min。

steps.title: 完成调整后的一行并比较
steps.text: 调整后合流量是 200 + 200 = 400 cm³/min，因此第二格时间为 7200 ÷ 400 = 18 min。两格之间的箭头表示 24 − 18 = 6 minutes 更快。

questions.question: A car left P at 9:00 at 90 km/h, reached Q 1:00. A lorry left Q at 10:00 and met it after 1/4 distance. Find car distance at meeting and lorry travel time.
questions.hint: Underline the given values. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Use the four equal route units and the clock strip: the car covers three units while the lorry covers one.

steps.title: Make the four-unit route
steps.text: The car travels from 9 am to 1 pm for 4 h at 90 km/h, so P–Q is 90 × 4 = 360 km. One of the 4 equal units is 360 ÷ 4 = 90 km.

steps.title: Read the meeting sections
steps.text: At the meeting, the car’s shaded 3 units are 3 × 90 = 270 km. The lorry’s section from Q is the remaining 1 unit, or 90 km.

steps.title: Use the clock strip for the lorry
steps.text: The car takes 270 ÷ 90 = 3 h to the meeting. The lorry starts 1 h later, so its clock strip is 2 h. Its speed is 90 ÷ 2 = 45 km/h, and the full 360 km route takes 360 ÷ 45 = 8 h.

zh-Hans.strategy: 用 4 等份路线条和时间线：汽车走了 3 份，货车走了 1 份。

steps.title: 画出 4 等份路线
steps.text: 汽车从 9 am 到 1 pm 行驶 4 h，速度为 90 km/h，所以 P–Q 是 90 × 4 = 360 km。4 个等份中的每一份是 360 ÷ 4 = 90 km。

steps.title: 读出会面时的两段
steps.text: 会面时，汽车涂色的 3 份是 3 × 90 = 270 km。货车从 Q 走的是剩下的 1 份，即 90 km。

steps.title: 用货车的时间线
steps.text: 汽车到会面点需 270 ÷ 90 = 3 h。货车晚 1 h 出发，所以时间线显示它行驶 2 h。货车速度为 90 ÷ 2 = 45 km/h，走完全程 360 km 需要 360 ÷ 45 = 8 h。

questions.question: Jack drove at 80 km/h for the first 5/9 of a journey. He drove the remaining 24 km in 12 minutes. Find (a) the total time taken and (b) his speed for the second part of the journey.
questions.hint: Underline the given values. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Use the nine equal route cells: the final 4 cells are 24 km, so every cell has the same distance.

steps.title: Label one route unit
steps.text: The final 4/9 is 24 km, so 1/9 is 24 ÷ 4 = 6 km. The first 5 cells therefore show 5 × 6 = 30 km.

steps.title: Read the first-part time
steps.text: The first block takes 30 ÷ 80 = 0.375 h = 22.5 min. Adding the labelled final 12 min gives 22.5 + 12 = 34.5 minutes.

steps.title: Convert the final time for the rate
steps.text: The final strip is 12 min = 0.2 h. Its speed is 24 ÷ 0.2 = 120 km/h.

zh-Hans.strategy: 用 9 个等格的路程条：最后 4 格是 24 km，所以每一格距离相同。

steps.title: 标出 1 个路程单位
steps.text: 最后的 4/9 是 24 km，所以 1/9 是 24 ÷ 4 = 6 km。因此前 5 格为 5 × 6 = 30 km。

steps.title: 读出第 1 段时间
steps.text: 第 1 段需要 30 ÷ 80 = 0.375 h = 22.5 min。加上图中最后一段的 12 min，得到 22.5 + 12 = 34.5 minutes。

steps.title: 把最后一段时间换成小时
steps.text: 最后一段为 12 min = 0.2 h。它的速度是 24 ÷ 0.2 = 120 km/h。

questions.question: Tom started from A for B at 5:45 am. Jane started along the same route 2 hours later at 100 km/h. She overtook Tom after completing 3/5 of her journey and reached B 4 hours later. Find (a) the distance Tom was from B when Jane overtook him, (b) Tom’s speed, and (c) the time Tom reached B.
questions.hint: Underline the given values. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Use the five-unit overtaking bar and its time strip: Jane’s 3-unit section is paired with Tom’s 2-hour earlier start.

steps.title: Read Jane’s three-unit section
steps.text: The bar labels Jane’s 3/5 section as 600 km. Therefore 1 unit is 600 ÷ 3 = 200 km, and all 5 units make 5 × 200 = 1000 km.

steps.title: Match the overtaking times
steps.text: Jane’s 600 km section at 100 km/h takes 600 ÷ 100 = 6 h. Tom started 2 h earlier, so the paired time strip gives him 6 + 2 = 8 h to the same point.

steps.title: Finish the full-route calculation
steps.text: Tom’s speed shown by the route-and-time comparison is 600 ÷ 8 = 75 km/h. The full-route strip gives 1000 ÷ 75 = 13 h 20 min; from 5:45 am, that ends at 7:05 pm.

zh-Hans.strategy: 用 5 等份追及路线条和时间线：Jane 的 3 份路程与 Tom 提前 2 h 出发对应。

steps.title: 读出 Jane 的 3 份路程
steps.text: 路程条把 Jane 的 3/5 标为 600 km。因此 1 份为 600 ÷ 3 = 200 km，全部 5 份为 5 × 200 = 1000 km。

steps.title: 对齐追及时刻
steps.text: Jane 以 100 km/h 走 600 km 需要 600 ÷ 100 = 6 h。Tom 早出发 2 h，所以时间线显示他到同一点用了 6 + 2 = 8 h。

steps.title: 完成全程计算
steps.text: 由路线和时间比较，Tom 的速度是 600 ÷ 8 = 75 km/h。全程条给出 1000 ÷ 75 = 13 h 20 min；从 5:45 am 起算，到达时刻是 7:05 pm。

questions.question: Motorist A left P 9:30 at 80 km/h and arrived Q 3:30. B left 2 h later at 100 km/h. Find B arrival and speed needed to arrive 3:30.
questions.hint: Underline the given values. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Fill the distance–speed–time table, then use the labelled clock timeline to compare B’s two possible travel times.

steps.title: Complete motorist A’s row
steps.text: A travels from 9:30 to 3:30 for 6 h. At 80 km/h, the table gives P–Q = 80 × 6 = 480 km.

steps.title: Follow B’s normal clock arcs
steps.text: For B, 480 ÷ 100 = 4.8 h = 4 h 48 min. Starting at 11:30, the timeline’s four 1-hour arcs, then 30 min and 18 min, end at 4:18 pm.

steps.title: Highlight the 3:30 target
steps.text: From 11:30 to 3:30, the highlighted timeline is 4 h. To cover the same 480 km in 4 h, B needs 480 ÷ 4 = 120 km/h.

zh-Hans.strategy: 先完成距离—速度—时间表，再用标有刻度的时间线比较 B 的两种行驶时间。

steps.title: 完成驾车人 A 的一行
steps.text: A 从 9:30 到 3:30 行驶 6 h。以 80 km/h 行驶，表中得到 P–Q = 80 × 6 = 480 km。

steps.title: 沿 B 的正常时间线读刻度
steps.text: B 需要 480 ÷ 100 = 4.8 h = 4 h 48 min。从 11:30 开始，时间线上的 4 个 1 h 弧、再加 30 min 和 18 min，终点是 4:18 pm。

steps.title: 突出 3:30 的目标时刻
steps.text: 从 11:30 到 3:30 的突出时间段为 4 h。B 要在 4 h 内走同样的 480 km，所需速度是 480 ÷ 4 = 120 km/h。

questions.question: Train A ran X→Z at 160 km/h. Train B took 6 h; both passed Y 2:00 and B reached Z 4:00; Y–Z was 400 km. Find A departure and arrival.
questions.hint: Underline the given values. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Work backward along the X–Y–Z route strip: find B’s speed on Y–Z, use B’s full 6-hour bar for X–Y, then place A’s 5-hour bar ending at 2 pm.

steps.title: Label B’s route and time bars
steps.text: B travels the 400 km Y–Z segment from 2 pm to 4 pm, or 2 h. So B’s speed is 400 ÷ 2 = 200 km/h. Its 6-hour bar leaves 6 − 2 = 4 h for X–Y, giving X–Y = 200 × 4 = 800 km.

steps.title: Work backward to A’s departure
steps.text: A’s parallel X–Y bar is 800 ÷ 160 = 5 h. Since it ends at Y at 2 pm, A starts at 9:00 am.

steps.title: Extend A’s bar to Z
steps.text: The full route is 800 + 400 = 1200 km. At 160 km/h, A needs 1200 ÷ 160 = 7.5 h = 7 h 30 min, so 9:00 am + 7 h 30 min = 4:30 pm.

zh-Hans.strategy: 沿 X–Y–Z 路线条倒推：先用 B 在 Y–Z 的速度，再用 B 的 6 h 时间条求 X–Y，最后把 A 在 2 pm 结束的 5 h 时间条向前推。

steps.title: 标出 B 的路程和时间条
steps.text: B 从 2 pm 到 4 pm 走完 Y–Z 的 400 km，共 2 h。因此 B 的速度是 400 ÷ 2 = 200 km/h。B 的全程时间条是 6 h，X–Y 用时为 6 − 2 = 4 h，所以 X–Y = 200 × 4 = 800 km。

steps.title: 倒推 A 的出发时刻
steps.text: A 在平行的 X–Y 时间条上用时 800 ÷ 160 = 5 h。它在 2 pm 到 Y，因此出发时刻是 9:00 am。

steps.title: 把 A 的时间条延长到 Z

questions.question: A warehouse held 4000 towels. The ratio of blue towels to red towels was 2:1, and the rest were white. After 1/4 of the blue towels and 1/2 of the white towels were sold, 2400 towels remained. Find the initial total number of red and white towels.
questions.hint: Underline the given values. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Use the segmented towel model: scale blue:red from 2:1 to 4:2, mark the 1600 towels sold, and compare the equal red and blue sections.

steps.title: Set up the first segmented bar
steps.text: Scale blue:red = 2:1 to 4:2. The 4000-total bar is shown as red, red, blue, blue, blue, blue, white, white, so the red and blue sections can be compared in whole equal cells.

steps.title: Mark the sold section
steps.text: The after-sale bar leaves 2400 towels, so its bracketed sold amount is 4000 − 2400 = 1600 towels.

steps.title: Use the equal-unit comparison
steps.text: In the model, blue is 2 equal units and red is 2 equal units. The red-and-white bracket is therefore 2 lots of the 1600 sold section: 1600 × 2 = 3200 red and white towels.

en.answerCheck: Checked answer: 3200 red and white towels.

zh-Hans.strategy: 使用分段毛巾条：把 blue:red 从 2:1 扩成 4:2，标出卖出的 1600 条，再比较相等的 red 和 blue 单位段。

steps.title: 画出第一条分段模型
steps.text: 把 blue:red = 2:1 扩成 4:2。总数 4000 的条形图依次为 red、red、blue、blue、blue、blue、white、white，这样可以用完整等格比较 red 和 blue 部分。

steps.title: 标出售出的部分
steps.text: 售后条形图还剩 2400 条，所以括号标出的售出数量为 4000 − 2400 = 1600 条。

steps.title: 利用相等单位的比较
steps.text: 在图中，blue 为 2 个等单位，red 也为 2 个等单位。因此 red 和 white 的括号部分是售出 1600 条的 2 倍：1600 × 2 = 3200 条 red and white towels。

zh-Hans.answerCheck: 答案：3200 red and white towels。

questions.question: Jar A:B beads were 2:3 and B:C were 2:1. Equal transfers B→A/C make A=B and C=297. Find total beads.
questions.hint: Underline the given values. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Follow the A:B:C ratio table: make B common, scale to whole transfer units, then apply the +2, −4, +2 change row.

steps.title: Make one three-column ratio
steps.text: The table first aligns A:B = 2:3 and B:C = 2:1 as A:B:C = 4:6:3. Multiply every column by 3 to get 12:18:9.

steps.title: Apply the transfer arrows
steps.text: B gives 2 units to A and 2 units to C, so the table changes by +2, −4, +2. Thus 12:18:9 becomes 14:14:11.

steps.title: Value a unit and total the columns
steps.text: C’s 11 units equal 297, so 1 unit is 297 ÷ 11 = 27. The total is 14 + 14 + 11 = 39 units, and 39 × 27 = 1053 beads.

zh-Hans.strategy: 按 A:B:C 比例表计算：先把 B 对齐，再扩成可转移的整数单位，最后应用 +2、−4、+2 的变换行。

steps.title: 合并成三栏比例
steps.text: 表中先把 A:B = 2:3 和 B:C = 2:1 对齐成 A:B:C = 4:6:3。每栏同乘 3，得到 12:18:9。

steps.title: 应用转移箭头
steps.text: B 给 A 2 个单位、给 C 2 个单位，所以表中变化为 +2、−4、+2。12:18:9 变为 14:14:11。

questions.question: 1/3 of party people were men. After 1/2 men and 8 women left, women exceeded men by 96 before the women left. Find final men:women ratio.
questions.hint: Underline the given values. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Use the aligned men/women bars after half the men leave: the women’s extra 3 units are 96, then remove the separate 8-woman block.

steps.title: Read the remaining-unit bars
steps.text: The men row has 2 equal cells, with 1 shaded as the half that left, leaving 1 unit. The women row has 4 units, so its extra 3 units over the men are labelled 96.

steps.title: Find the unit size
steps.text: The brace gives 3 units = 96, so 1 unit = 96 ÷ 3 = 32. The women’s 4 units are 4 × 32 = 128.

steps.title: Remove the 8-woman block
steps.text: After 8 women leave, women remaining are 128 − 8 = 120, while men remaining are 32. The final strip is 32:120 = 4:15.

zh-Hans.strategy: 使用一半男士离开后的对齐男女格条：女士多出的 3 个单位是 96，再减去单独标出的 8 名女士。

steps.title: 读出留下人数的单位条
steps.text: 男士一行有 2 个等格，其中 1 格涂色表示离开的一半，留下 1 个单位。女士一行有 4 个单位，比男士多出的 3 个单位标为 96。

steps.title: 求每单位人数
steps.text: 括号给出 3 个单位 = 96，所以 1 个单位 = 96 ÷ 3 = 32。女士的 4 个单位为 4 × 32 = 128。

steps.title: 减去 8 名女士的方块
steps.text: 8 名女士离开后，女士剩下 128 − 8 = 120，男士剩下 32。最后比例条为 32:120 = 4:15。

questions.question: Cindy:Mark marbles were 3:2 of total 80. After Cindy gave away some, she had 1/4 as many as Mark. How many did Cindy give away?
questions.hint: Underline the given values. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Use the two-row Cindy–Mark bar: first split 80 in 3:2, then use the four-unit comparison to identify Cindy’s remaining 8 marbles.

steps.title: Fill the starting bars
steps.text: Cindy:Mark = 3:2, so the two bars have 3 + 2 = 5 equal units. One unit is 80 ÷ 5 = 16, giving Cindy 48 marbles and Mark 32 marbles.

steps.title: Use the four-unit comparison
steps.text: The model labels Mark’s unchanged bar as 32 and divides that comparison into 4 equal units. Thus 4 units = 32 and 1 unit = 8; Cindy’s final bar is 1 of those 4 units, or 8 marbles.

steps.title: Compare Cindy’s before and after bars
steps.text: Cindy started with 48 marbles and the final comparison bar shows 8. She gave away 48 − 8 = 40 marbles.

zh-Hans.strategy: 用 Cindy–Mark 的两行条形图：先把 80 按 3:2 分配，再用 4 单位比较读出 Cindy 剩下的 8 颗。

steps.title: 填入起初的两条格条
steps.text: Cindy:Mark = 3:2，因此两条格条共有 3 + 2 = 5 个等单位。1 个单位是 80 ÷ 5 = 16，所以 Cindy 有 48 颗，Mark 有 32 颗。

steps.title: 利用 4 单位比较
steps.text: 图中 Mark 不变的格条标为 32，并把比较段分成 4 个等单位。因此 4 个单位 = 32，1 个单位 = 8；Cindy 最后的格条是这 4 个单位中的 1 个，即 8 颗。

steps.title: 比较 Cindy 的前后格条
steps.text: Cindy 起初有 48 颗，最后比较条显示 8 颗。她送出 48 − 8 = 40 颗。

questions.question: At a country club, the ratio of men to women was 2:3. 1/4 of the men and 1/2 of the women left. The number of people remaining was 24 more than the number who left. Find the initial attendance.
questions.hint: Underline the given values. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Use the source’s six-unit and four-unit bars for people remaining and people leaving, then reconstruct the initial 10-unit whole.

steps.title: Read the two comparison bars
steps.text: After the stated fractions leave, the diagram represents people remaining by 6 equal units and people who left by 4 equal units. The unshared difference is 24.

steps.title: Find the value of a unit
steps.text: The bracket gives 6 units − 4 units = 24, so 2 units = 24 and 1 unit = 12.

steps.title: Rebuild the original whole
steps.text: The initial attendance is the 6-unit remaining bar plus the 4-unit leaving bar: 6 + 4 = 10 units. Therefore 10 × 12 = 120 people.

zh-Hans.strategy: 用原图中留下的 6 单位条和离开的 4 单位条，再重建起初的 10 单位总数。

steps.title: 读出两条比较格条
steps.text: 按题目给出的离开分数，图中把留下的人表示为 6 个等单位，把离开的人表示为 4 个等单位。两条未重合部分的差是 24。

steps.title: 求每单位人数
steps.text: 括号表示 6 个单位 − 4 个单位 = 24，所以 2 个单位 = 24，1 个单位 = 12。

steps.title: 重建起初总人数
steps.text: 起初人数是留下的 6 单位加离开的 4 单位：6 + 4 = 10 个单位。因此 10 × 12 = 120 people。

questions.question: Mandy:Jack sweets were 5:7; after Mandy gave Jack sweets, ratio became 3:21. Jack initially had 168. How many must Jack return to equalise?
questions.hint: Underline the given values. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Use the Mandy–Jack–total ratio table: scale the initial 5:7:12 row, place the 3:21:24 row after Mandy’s transfer, then move to the equal 12:12:24 row.

steps.title: Scale the initial row
steps.text: The initial table row Mandy:Jack:total = 5:7:12 is doubled to 10:14:24. Since Jack’s 14 units equal 168 sweets, 1 unit is 168 ÷ 14 = 12 sweets.

steps.title: Read the after-Mandy-transfer row
steps.text: After Mandy gives sweets, the table shows 3:21:24. To make the two columns equal, Jack must return sweets until the row becomes 12:12:24.

steps.title: Measure Jack’s return
steps.text: Jack’s column changes from 21 units to 12 units, a return of 21 − 12 = 9 units. Thus he returns 9 × 12 = 108 sweets.

zh-Hans.strategy: 使用 Mandy–Jack–total 比例表：先把初始的 5:7:12 行放大，再写 Mandy 转移后的 3:21:24 行，最后变到相等的 12:12:24 行。

steps.title: 放大初始行
steps.text: 初始表格 Mandy:Jack:total = 5:7:12，加倍为 10:14:24。Jack 的 14 个单位等于 168 颗糖，所以 1 个单位是 168 ÷ 14 = 12 颗。

steps.title: 读出 Mandy 转移后的行
steps.text: Mandy 给出糖果后，表中为 3:21:24。要让两栏相等，Jack 要归还糖果，直到该行变为 12:12:24。

steps.title: 量出 Jack 归还的单位数
steps.text: Jack 一栏从 21 个单位变为 12 个单位，归还了 21 − 12 = 9 个单位。因此他归还 9 × 12 = 108 颗糖。

questions.question: The ratio of A’s sweets to B’s sweets was 7:4, and the ratio of B’s sweets to C’s sweets was 3:2. After 36 sweets were removed from A, C had 2/3 as many sweets as A. Find the total number of sweets left.
questions.hint: Underline the given values. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Use the ratio ladder and three-row bars: align A:B:C, then compare A’s removed 9 cells with the 36-sweets label.

steps.title: Build the aligned ratio ladder
steps.text: Make B common: A:B:C = 7:4:3 becomes 21:12:9. After removal, the diagram shows 12:12:8, matching C as 2/3 of A because 8 is 2/3 of 12.

steps.title: Value the removed cells
steps.text: A changes from 21 units to 12 units, so its shaded removed part is 21 − 12 = 9 units. The bar labels this part 36 sweets, hence 1 unit = 36 ÷ 9 = 4 sweets.

steps.title: Total the remaining bars
steps.text: The three remaining bars contain 12 + 12 + 8 = 32 units. Therefore the total sweets left are 32 × 4 = 128 sweets.

zh-Hans.strategy: 使用比例阶梯和 A、B、C 三条格条：先对齐 A:B:C，再把 A 被取走的 9 格与 36 颗糖对应。

steps.title: 画出对齐的比例阶梯
steps.text: 把 B 对齐：A:B:C = 7:4:3 变为 21:12:9。取走后图中为 12:12:8；因为 8 是 12 的 2/3，所以符合 C 是 A 的 2/3。

steps.title: 求被取走格子的单位值
steps.text: A 从 21 个单位变为 12 个单位，因此涂色的取走部分是 21 − 12 = 9 个单位。图中该部分标为 36 颗糖，所以 1 个单位 = 36 ÷ 9 = 4 颗。

steps.title: 合计剩下的三条格条
steps.text: 剩下的三条格条共有 12 + 12 + 8 = 32 个单位。因此剩下糖果总数是 32 × 4 = 128 sweets。

questions.question: 1580 people were on a ship; 60% adults. Adults alighted until adults were 20% of remaining. Find adults alighting and final children:adults ratio.
questions.hint: Underline the given values. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Use the before/after percentage table: keep the child block fixed at 632 while it changes from 40% to 80% of the new total.

steps.title: Fill the before column
steps.text: Using the visual model above, Before adults alight, adults are 60% of 1580: 0.60 × 1580 = 948. The children block is 1580 − 948 = 632, or 40%.

steps.title: Read the fixed child block after
steps.text: No children alight, so the same 632 block is 80% after the change. The adults block is then 20%, so adults remaining are 632 ÷ 80 × 20 = 158.

steps.title: Compare adult blocks and simplify
steps.text: The adult blocks show 948 − 158 = 790 adults alighting. The after column gives children:adults = 632:158 = 4:1.

zh-Hans.strategy: 用前后百分比表：保持 children 的 632 方块不变，它从新变化前的 40% 变为变化后的 80%。

steps.title: 填入变化前的一列
steps.text: 成年人下船前，adults 是 1580 的 60%：0.60 × 1580 = 948。children 方块为 1580 − 948 = 632，也就是 40%。

steps.title: 读出变化后固定的 children 方块
steps.text: 没有 children 下船，所以同一个 632 方块在变化后占 80%。adults 方块占 20%，留下的 adults 为 632 ÷ 80 × 20 = 158。

steps.title: 比较 adults 方块并化简比例
steps.text: 两个 adults 方块相差 948 − 158 = 790，表示下船的成年人。变化后 children:adults = 632:158 = 4:1。

questions.question: Chocolate cakes cost $4; strawberry cost $3 more than 2 chocolate cakes. Cake counts were 5:3 and Gibbs sold 8 more. Find total sales.
questions.hint: Label each money amount. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Use the 5-unit chocolate bar and 3-unit strawberry bar. The exposed 2 units give the value of one unit before the two cake sales are added.

steps.title: Value one bar unit
steps.text: The diagram shows that the extra 2 units of chocolate cakes equal 8 cakes. So 1 unit = 8 ÷ 2 = 4 cakes.

steps.title: Find each cake count
steps.text: Chocolate cakes = 5 × 4 = 20. Strawberry cakes = 3 × 4 = 12.

steps.title: Price both parts
steps.text: Chocolate sales = 20 × $4 = $80. One strawberry cake costs 2 × $4 + $3 = $11, so strawberry sales = 12 × $11 = $132. Total = $80 + $132 = $212.

zh-Hans.strategy: 利用图中的 5 个巧克力单位和 3 个草莓单位。多出的 2 个单位确定每个单位的数量，再分别计算两种蛋糕的销售额。

steps.title: 求 1 个单位
steps.text: 图中巧克力蛋糕多出的 2 个单位是 8 个蛋糕，所以 1 个单位 = 8 ÷ 2 = 4 个蛋糕。

steps.title: 求两种蛋糕的数量
steps.text: 巧克力蛋糕有 5 × 4 = 20 个；草莓蛋糕有 3 × 4 = 12 个。

questions.question: Susan sold 1/2 charity tickets; Mark:Jane sold rest 5:3 and Mark exceeded Jane by 18. Tickets cost $1.20. Find total collection.
questions.hint: Label each money amount. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Read Mark and Jane as the 5-unit and 3-unit bars, then double their combined tickets because Susan sold one half of all tickets.

steps.title: Find one unit
steps.text: Mark exceeds Jane by 2 units, and the diagram labels those 2 units as 18 tickets. Thus 1 unit = 18 ÷ 2 = 9 tickets.

steps.title: Find all tickets
steps.text: Mark and Jane sold 5 + 3 = 8 units, or 8 × 9 = 72 tickets. This is the half not sold by Susan, so all tickets = 2 × 72 = 144.

steps.title: Find the collection
steps.text: At $1.20 per ticket, the collection is 144 × $1.20 = $172.80.

zh-Hans.strategy: 把马克和简看作图中的 5 个单位和 3 个单位。两人卖出的票是总票数的一半，所以求出后要加倍。

steps.title: 求 1 个单位
steps.text: 马克比简多 2 个单位，图中这 2 个单位是 18 张票。因此 1 个单位 = 18 ÷ 2 = 9 张票。

steps.title: 求总票数
steps.text: 马克和简卖出 5 + 3 = 8 个单位，即 8 × 9 = 72 张票。这是苏珊未卖出的那一半，所以总票数 = 2 × 72 = 144 张。

questions.question: Alvin:Zachary:Philip money was 2:5:3. Zachary spent 20%; his remainder was $196 below Alvin-plus-Philip. How much more did Alvin-plus-Zachary have than Philip?
questions.hint: Label each money amount. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Compare the before-and-after ratio strips. Zachary spends one of his five units, and that one-unit change is the labelled $196 gap.

steps.title: Show Zachary after spending
steps.text: 20% of Zachary’s 5 units is 1 unit. His bar changes from 5 units to 4 units, while Alvin and Philip remain 2 units and 3 units.

steps.title: Value a unit
steps.text: After the spending, Alvin plus Philip is 2 + 3 = 5 units and Zachary has 4 units. Their difference is 1 unit = $196.

steps.title: Use the original bars
steps.text: Originally Alvin plus Zachary exceeds Philip by (2 + 5 − 3) = 4 units. So the difference is 4 × $196 = $784.

zh-Hans.strategy: 比较图中原来和后来两条比例带。扎卡里从 5 个单位中花掉 1 个单位，这个单位正是标出的 $196 差额。

steps.title: 画出花钱后的比例
steps.text: 扎卡里原有 5 个单位，花掉其中的 20%，即 1 个单位，所以剩下 4 个单位。阿尔文和菲利普仍分别是 2 个单位和 3 个单位。

steps.title: 求 1 个单位的金额
steps.text: 花钱后，阿尔文加菲利普是 2 + 3 = 5 个单位，扎卡里是 4 个单位，相差 1 个单位 = $196。

steps.title: 回到原来的比例
steps.text: 原来阿尔文加扎卡里比菲利普多 (2 + 5 − 3) = 4 个单位，所以多 4 × $196 = $784。

questions.question: 40% of adults left a party; 10% of leavers were men. Men leaving:remaining was 2:5; 105 men were initially present. Find initial women.
questions.hint: Underline the given values. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Follow the diagram’s chain from the 2:5 men bars to the percentage bars for all leavers and then all adults.

steps.title: Find the men who left
steps.text: The 7 units for men who left and stayed equal 105 men, so 1 unit = 105 ÷ 7 = 15. Men who left = 2 × 15 = 30.

steps.title: Find the original adults
steps.text: The diagram marks 30 men as 10% of all leavers, so all leavers = 30 ÷ 10% = 300. Those 300 adults are 40% of the original adults, so the original number of adults = 300 ÷ 40% = 750.

steps.title: Remove the men
steps.text: Initial women = 750 − 105 = 645.

zh-Hans.strategy: 按照图示，从离开和留下男子的 2:5 单位条，依次连接到所有离开者和所有成人的百分比条。

steps.title: 求离开的男子人数
steps.text: 离开和留下的男子共 7 个单位，对应 105 人，所以 1 个单位 = 105 ÷ 7 = 15 人。离开的男子 = 2 × 15 = 30 人。

steps.title: 求原来成人总数
steps.text: 图中 30 名男子是所有离开者的 10%，所以所有离开者 = 30 ÷ 10% = 300 人。这 300 人是原来成人的 40%，所以原来成人总数 = 300 ÷ 40% = 750 人。

questions.question: Kate took 30% biscuits; Melissa 25%; Jack took final 80; Ann took 20 more than Melissa. What percentage did Ann take?
questions.hint: Underline the given values. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Use the 10-cell percentage bar. Its final 20% section combines Ann’s extra 20 biscuits with Jack’s 80 biscuits.

steps.title: Value the percentage bar
steps.text: The final 20% of the bar is 20 + 80 = 100 biscuits. Therefore 10% = 50 biscuits and 100% = 500 biscuits.

steps.title: Convert Ann’s extra biscuits
steps.text: Ann took 20 more biscuits than Melissa. As a share of 500, 20 biscuits = 20 ÷ 500 × 100% = 4%.

steps.title: Add to Melissa’s share
steps.text: Melissa took 25%, so Ann took 25% + 4% = 29%.

zh-Hans.strategy: 使用 10 格百分比条。最后的 20% 一段由安多拿的 20 块饼干和杰克拿的 80 块组成。

steps.title: 把安多拿的饼干化成百分比
steps.text: 安比梅利莎多拿 20 块。占 500 块的百分比是 20 ÷ 500 × 100% = 4%。

steps.title: 加到梅利莎的百分比
steps.text: 梅利莎拿了 25%，所以安拿了 25% + 4% = 29%。

questions.question: Uncle Sam receives 20% of each $8 cup price plus 5% price for every 10 cups. He collected $86.80. How many cups did he sell?
questions.hint: Label each money amount. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Use the guess-and-check table after finding the earnings for one cup and for each group of ten cups.

steps.title: Find the two earnings rates
steps.text: 20% of $8 is $1.60 for each cup. The extra 5% of $8 for every 10 cups is $0.40 per group of 10.

steps.title: Read the table trial
steps.text: For 50 cups, the table gives 50 × $1.60 + 5 × $0.40 = $82. This is $86.80 − $82 = $4.80 short.

steps.title: Add the missing cups
steps.text: The $4.80 difference buys 4.80 ÷ 1.60 = 3 more cups; it does not complete another group of 10. Thus 50 + 3 = 53 cups.

zh-Hans.strategy: 先求每杯和每 10 杯带来的收入，再按照猜测与检验表继续。

questions.question: 20% of a class are boys. 20% boys and 10% girls keep pets; 144 girls do not. How many children keep pets?
questions.hint: Underline the given values. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Partition the whole-class percentage bar into boys and girls, then locate the pet-keeping sections within both parts.

steps.title: Use the girls-without-pets section
steps.text: Using the visual model above, Girls are 100% − 20% = 80% of the class. 90% of those girls have no pets, so this is 90% × 80% = 72% of the class = 144 children. Hence 1% = 2 children.

steps.title: Find both pet sections
steps.text: Boys with pets are 20% of 20% = 4% of the class. Girls with pets are 10% of 80% = 8% of the class.

steps.title: Combine the sections
steps.text: Children with pets make up 4% + 8% = 12% of the class, or 12 × 2 = 24 children.

zh-Hans.strategy: 把全班百分比条分成男生和女生，再在两部分中找出养宠物的区域。

steps.title: 利用女生中不养宠物的部分
steps.text: 结合上面的图示模型，女生占全班 100% − 20% = 80%。其中 90% 不养宠物，所以占全班 90% × 80% = 72%，即 144 人。因此 1% = 2 人。

steps.title: 求两部分养宠物的百分比
steps.text: 养宠物的男生占全班 20% 的 20%，即 4%。养宠物的女生占全班 80% 的 10%，即 8%。

questions.question: 2/5 marbles were red. Of the remainder, 10% were blue and 10% green. Yellow exceeded red by 32. Find blue-plus-green count.
questions.hint: Underline the given values. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Use the percentage-bar model to partition the whole by colour. Blue and green each take 10% of the 60% remaining after red.

steps.title: Fill the percentage partitions
steps.text: Using the visual model above, Red = 2/5 = 40%, so 60% remains. Blue = 10% of 60% = 6%, and green = 6%; therefore yellow = 60% − 6% − 6% = 48%.

steps.title: Value 1%
steps.text: Yellow exceeds red by 48% − 40% = 8%, and this equals 32 marbles. So 1% = 32 ÷ 8 = 4 marbles.

steps.title: Take the blue-and-green section
steps.text: Blue plus green is 6% + 6% = 12%, so it contains 12 × 4 = 48 marbles.

zh-Hans.strategy: 使用百分比条形模型按颜色把整体分成百分比部分。红色之后剩下的 60% 中，蓝色和绿色各占其中的 10%。

steps.title: 填出各颜色的百分比
steps.text: 结合上面的图示模型，红色占 2/5 = 40%，剩下 60%。蓝色占 60% 的 10%，即 6%；绿色也是 6%，所以黄色占 60% − 6% − 6% = 48%。

steps.title: 取蓝色和绿色部分
steps.text: 蓝色加绿色占 6% + 6% = 12%，所以有 12 × 4 = 48 颗弹珠。

zh-Hans.answerCheck: 答案：48 颗蓝色和绿色弹珠

questions.question: Jane had 40% more marbles than Jeffrey. Jane lost 12 and gave Jeffrey 16, then they matched. Find original counts.
questions.hint: Underline the given values. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Use the 140% Jane bar and 100% Jeffrey bar. The diagram’s 16, 16, and 12 pieces make the original 40% difference.

steps.title: Match the 40% extension
steps.text: After Jane loses 12 and gives Jeffrey 16, equality requires the original difference to cover 12 + 16 + 16 = 44. Thus 40% = 44.

steps.title: Scale Jane’s bar
steps.text: Jane’s original bar is 140%, so Jane had 44 ÷ 40 × 140 = 154 marbles.

steps.title: Scale Jeffrey’s bar
steps.text: Jeffrey’s original bar is 100%, so Jeffrey had 44 ÷ 40 × 100 = 110 marbles.

zh-Hans.strategy: 使用图中的简 140% 条和杰弗里 100% 条。标出的 16、16 和 12 组成原来相差的 40%。

steps.title: 对应 40% 的长度
steps.text: 结合上面的图示模型，简丢 12 颗并给杰弗里 16 颗后相等，所以原来的差额 = 12 + 16 + 16 = 44。因此 40% = 44。

steps.title: 按杰弗里的比例条计算
steps.text: 杰弗里原来的数量是 100%，所以是 44 ÷ 40 × 100 = 110 颗。

questions.hint: Label each money amount. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Use the two saving percentage strips: a 50% increase on the first 10% saving adds 5%, so their difference values a percentage of the salary.

steps.title: Compare the saving strips
steps.text: Using the visual model above, 50% of the first month’s 10% saving is 5%. The second-month saving is 10% + 5% = 15%, so the difference is 5%.

steps.title: Multiply for six months
steps.text: Six months of salary = 6 × $9930 = $59580.

questions.question: A square had area 625 cm². Each side increased 40%. Find percentage area increase.
questions.hint: Label the given measures. Draw a model, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Use the two square diagrams: recover the original side from its area, extend the side to 140%, then compare the two areas.

steps.title: Find the original side
steps.text: Using the visual model above, The original area is 625 cm², so its side is √625 = 25 cm.

steps.title: Build the enlarged square
steps.text: 10% of 25 cm is 2.5 cm. A 40% increase makes the side 25 + 4 × 2.5 = 35 cm, so the new area is 35 × 35 = 1225 cm².

steps.title: Compare the areas
steps.text: The increase is 1225 − 625 = 600 cm². As a percentage of 625 cm², this is 600 ÷ 625 × 100% = 96%.

zh-Hans.strategy: 使用两个正方形图：先由面积求原边长，把边长增加到 140%，再比较两个面积。

steps.title: 求原来的边长
steps.text: 结合上面的图示模型，原面积是 625 cm²，所以边长 = √625 = 25 cm。

questions.question: 80% of books were second-hand. 10% new and 60% second-hand were English. Adding 15 English gave English:Chinese 3:2. Find initial English and final total.
questions.hint: Underline the given values. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Build the percentage partition for new and second-hand books, then use the before-and-after English:Chinese unit bars.

steps.title: Find the language shares
steps.text: New books are 20% and second-hand books are 80%. English books are 10% of 20% = 2% plus 60% of 80% = 48%, giving 50% English; Chinese books are the other 50%.

steps.title: Use the changing ratio
steps.text: Initially English:Chinese is 50%:50% = 2 units:2 units. After 15 English books are added, the ratio becomes 3 units:2 units, so 1 unit = 15 books.

steps.title: Read both requested amounts
steps.text: Initial English books = 2 × 15 = 30. The initial total is 4 × 15 = 60, so the final total is 60 + 15 = 75 books.

zh-Hans.strategy: 先建立新书和二手书的百分比分区，再使用英语书与中文书前后变化的单位条。

steps.title: 求两种语言书的占比
steps.text: 新书占 20%，二手书占 80%。英语书占新书的 10%，即 20% 的 10% = 2%，再占二手书的 60%，即 80% 的 60% = 48%，共 50%；中文书也占 50%。

steps.title: 使用变化后的比例
steps.text: 原来英语书：中文书 = 50%：50% = 2 个单位：2 个单位。增加 15 本英语书后变为 3 个单位：2 个单位，所以 1 个单位 = 15 本。

questions.question: In January Joyce kept 80% salary, gave 1/4 of it to mother, saved rest; food/clothing was unchanged in February. Mother’s February amount rose $150 and equalled savings. Find requested values.
questions.hint: Label each money amount. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Use the month-by-month 10-unit spending grid. February’s three mother units value a unit, which sets the 80% salary base and both requested quantities.

steps.title: Value the grid units
steps.text: The February mother bracket shows 3 units = $150. Therefore 1 unit = $150 ÷ 3 = $50, and the 10 units that represent 80% equal 10 × $50 = $500.

steps.title: Read the two requested changes
steps.text: In January, Joyce gave her mother 2 units = 2 × $50 = $100. In February she gave $150, an increase of $50; $50 ÷ $625 × 100% = 8%. Food and clothing are the unchanged 20%, so 20% of $625 = $125.

zh-Hans.strategy: 使用按月份画出的 10 个单位支出格。2 月给母亲的 3 个单位确定 1 个单位的金额，从而确定工资的 80% 和两个所求量。

questions.question: A theatre had 4500 seats: 10% first-class, 30% second-class, rest third-class. Add 200 first and 250 second. Find final first, second, and third percentage.
questions.hint: Underline the given values. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Follow the class table: calculate each original share of 4500, apply the two increases, then divide the unchanged third-class seats by the new total.

steps.title: Find first- and second-class seats
steps.text: Using the visual model above, First class starts at 10% × 4500 = 450 and ends at 450 + 200 = 650. Second class starts at 30% × 4500 = 1350 and ends at 1350 + 250 = 1600.

steps.title: Find the new total
steps.text: Third class remains 60% × 4500 = 2700 seats. The final total is 4500 + 200 + 250 = 4950 seats.

zh-Hans.strategy: 按照座位等级表，先算 4500 个座位中各等级原来的份额，加上两项增加量，最后用不变的三等座除以新总数。

questions.question: Jeremy and Alicia had $360; Jeremy had $24 more. Alicia spent 3 times Jeremy’s spending and retained 1/2 Jeremy’s remainder. Find Jeremy initial and remainder.
questions.hint: Label each money amount. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Use the spent-and-left bars. First split the $360 total using the $24 initial difference; then use Alicia’s half-left bar to value Jeremy’s remaining units.

steps.title: Find Jeremy’s initial amount
steps.text: Remove the $24 difference: $360 − $24 = $336. Split the equal part: $336 ÷ 2 = $168. Jeremy had the extra $24, so he started with $168 + $24 = $192.

steps.title: Set up the left-amount units
steps.text: Alicia’s left amount is half Jeremy’s left amount. The shaded part is 2 units + $24, so the diagram gives 5 units + $24 = $168.

steps.title: Find what Jeremy had left
steps.text: 5 units = $168 − $24 = $144, so 1 unit = $144 ÷ 5 = $28.80. Jeremy’s 4 units are 4 × $28.80 = $115.20; including the two $24 parts shown gives $115.20 + ($24 × 2) = $163.20.

zh-Hans.strategy: 使用花掉和剩下的钱的条形图。先用总数 $360 和相差 $24 求杰里米原有的钱，再利用艾丽西亚剩下的是一半的单位条求杰里米余款。

steps.title: 建立余款的单位关系
steps.text: 艾丽西亚剩下的钱是杰里米余款的一半。阴影部分是 2 个单位 + $24，所以图中给出 5 个单位 + $24 = $168。

questions.question: Crate A had 207 pears, 176 mangoes; B had 293 pears, 274 mangoes. Moving fruit B→A made pears 40% A and 70% B. Find fruit moved.
questions.hint: Underline the given values. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Use the fruit table to total pears and mangoes, turn the percentage labels into the two unit equations, then eliminate one crate variable.

steps.title: Total each fruit
steps.text: Using the visual model above, Pears total 293 + 207 = 500, and mangoes total 176 + 274 = 450. Let A and B be the final amounts of fruit in crates A and B.

steps.title: Use the percentage-unit equations
steps.text: For pears, 40% of A plus 70% of B gives 4A + 7B = 500. For mangoes, 60% of A plus 30% of B gives 6A + 3B = 450.

steps.title: Eliminate and count transfers
steps.text: Multiply the pear equation by 3 and the mango equation by 2: 12A + 21B = 1500 and 12A + 6B = 900. Subtracting gives 15B = 600, so B = 40 and 3B = 120 mangoes; 274 − 120 = 154 mangoes moved. Then 6A = 450 − 120 = 330, so A = 55 and 4A = 220 pears; 220 − 207 = 13 pears moved. Total moved = 154 + 13 = 167 fruit.

zh-Hans.strategy: 使用水果表先求梨和芒果总数，把百分比标签化成两个单位方程，再消去一个箱子的未知量。

steps.title: 求每种水果总数
steps.text: 梨总数 = 293 + 207 = 500，芒果总数 = 176 + 274 = 450。设 A 和 B 分别为转移后 A 箱和 B 箱的水果单位数。

steps.title: 列出百分比单位方程
steps.text: 梨的方程为 4A + 7B = 500，因为 A 中占 40%，B 中占 70%。芒果的方程为 6A + 3B = 450，因为 A 中占 60%，B 中占 30%。
